runDiscoveryPass() {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> feeds;\n    feeds.reserve(gInstruments.size());\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) feeds.push_back(kv.first);\n\n    UnionFind uf;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < feeds.size(); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < feeds.size(); ++j) {\n            InstrumentState& A = gInstruments[feeds[i]];\n            InstrumentState& B = gInstruments[feeds[j]];\n            if (static_cast<int>(A.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints ||\n                static_cast<int>(B.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            PairFit f = bestFit(A, B);\n            if (f.r2 >= cfg::kR2Floor) {\n                uf.unite(feeds[i], feeds[j]);\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PAIR_RELATED,\" << feeds[i] << \"-\" << feeds[j]\n                                  << \",r2=\" << f.r2 << \";lag=\" << f.lag\n                                  << \";aLeadsB=\" << (f.aLeadsB ? 1 : 0) << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> components;\n    for (auto& feed : feeds) {\n        if (uf.parent.count(feed)) components[uf.find(feed)].push_back(feed);\n    }\n\n    for (auto& kv : components) {\n        std::vector<std::string>& members = kv.second;\n        if (members.size() < 2) continue;\n\n        std::string bestFeed, bestSender;\n        double bestFrac = 0.0;\n        int strongCount = 0;\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            InstrumentState& st = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (st.totalTrades < cfg::kTradeWarmup) continue;\n            std::string domSender;\n            long long domCount = 0;\n            for (auto& sc : st.senderTradeCount) {\n                if (sc.second > domCount) {\n                    domCount = sc.second;\n                    domSender = sc.first;\n                }\n            }\n            double frac = st.totalTrades > 0 ? static_cast<double>(domCount) / st.totalTrades : 0.0;\n            if (frac >= cfg::kDominanceFloor) {\n                strongCount++;\n                if (frac > bestFrac) {\n                    bestFrac = frac;\n                    bestFeed = feed;\n                    bestSender = domSender;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (strongCount != 1) {\n            // Either nobody's dominant enough yet (still gathering data) or\n            // more than one member looks driver-shaped (ambiguous) -- log\n            // and wait for more data rather than guess.\n            if (strongCount > 1 && gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER,\";\n                for (auto& f : members) gDiscoveryLog << f << \";\";\n                gDiscoveryLog << \"\\n\";\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        InstrumentState& driverSt = gInstruments[bestFeed];\n        if (!driverSt.isDriver) {\n            driverSt.isDriver = true;\n            driverSt.moverSender = bestSender;\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",DRIVER_IDENTIFIED,\" << bestFeed\n                              << \",mover=\" << bestSender << \";frac=\" << bestFrac << \"\\n\";\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            if (feed == bestFeed) continue;\n            InstrumentState& pig = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (pig.isDriver) continue;  // defensive; shouldn't happen given union-find semantics\n            if (!pig.isPiggyback) {\n                pig.isPiggyback = true;\n                pig.driverFeed = bestFeed;\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PIGGYBACK_IDENTIFIED,\" << feed\n                                  << \",driver=\" << bestFeed << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Rel recovery (piggyback offset against its driver)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Attempts to recover/refresh a piggyback's fixed offset against its\n// driver. Fires on a \"requote burst\" (both sides move together -- the live\n// signature of the background bot repricing), gated by the mover-ownership\n// contamination guard described in the file header.\nstatic void tryRecoverRel(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback) return;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    bool bothMoved = pig.prevBidPx >= 0 && pig.prevAskPx >= 0 && pig.bidPx >= 0 && pig.askPx >= 0 &&\n                      pig.bidPx != pig.prevBidPx && pig.askPx != pig.prevAskPx;\n    if (!bothMoved) return;\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender) || bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender)) {\n        // Contaminated: the level we'd sample from is the mover's own\n        // resting quote, not the LP's rule. Skip this sample entirely.\n        return;\n    }\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = (static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(pig.askPx)) / 2.0;\n    double sample = driverFv - center;\n\n    pig.relSamples.push_back(sample);\n    while (pig.relSamples.size() > cfg::kRelWindow) pig.relSamples.pop_front();\n\n    double halfSpread = (static_cast<double>(pig.askPx) - static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx)) / 2.0;\n    if (!pig.haveObservedHalfSpread) {\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = halfSpread;\n        pig.haveObservedHalfSpread = true;\n    } else {\n        constexpr double kEmaAlpha = 0.2;\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = kEmaAlpha * halfSpread + (1 - kEmaAlpha) * pig.observedHalfSpread;\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relSamples.size() < cfg::kRelMinSamples) return;\n\n    std::vector<double> v(pig.relSamples.begin(), pig.relSamples.end());\n    double m = meanOf(v);\n    double var = 0.0;\n    for (double x : v) var += (x - m) * (x - m);\n    var /= static_cast<double>(v.size());\n    double sd = std::sqrt(var);\n    long long driverTick = drv.meta.ticksize > 0 ? drv.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double sdTicks = sd / static_cast<double>(driverTick);\n\n    bool wasTrusted = pig.relTrusted;\n    if (sdTicks < cfg::kRelTrustStdTicks) {\n        pig.rel = m;\n        pig.relTrusted = true;\n    } else {\n        pig.relTrusted = false;\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relTrusted && !wasTrusted) {\n        publishPairing(pig.feed, pig.driverFeed, pig.rel);\n        if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n            gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",REL_TRUSTED,\" << pig.feed << \",driver=\" << pig.driverFeed\n                          << \";rel=\" << pig.rel << \";sdTicks=\" << sdTicks << \"\\n\";\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Quoting\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DesiredQuote {\n    bool haveBid = false, haveAsk = false;\n    long long bidPx = 0, askPx = 0;\n    long long bidVol = 0, askVol = 0;\n};\n\n// Drivers are never quoted -- see file header. Only piggybacks with a\n// trusted rel get quotes, priced off the driver's fair value plus that\n// fixed offset, a couple of ticks inside the LP's own observed spread.\nstatic DesiredQuote computeQuotes(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    DesiredQuote q;\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback || !pig.relTrusted) return q;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return q;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = driverFv + pig.rel;\n\n    long long tick = pig.meta.ticksize > 0 ? pig.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double insideBy =\n        std::max(static_cast<double>(tick), pig.observedHalfSpread - cfg::kQuoteInsideTicks * tick);\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center - insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center + insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n\n    long long size = std::max<long long>(pig.meta.min_volume, 1);\n    // TODO (see file header): size should scale with headroom against\n    // meta.position_limit and, eventually, the hedger's netted exposure.\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    bool bidPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseBidUntil;\n    bool askPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseAskUntil;\n    bool bidMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool askMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    if (!bidPaused && !bidMoverOwned) {\n        q.haveBid = true;\n        q.bidPx = bidPx;\n        q.bidVol = size;\n    }\n    if (!askPaused && !askMoverOwned) {\n        q.haveAsk = true;\n        q.askPx = askPx;\n        q.askVol = size;\n    }\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> A <FEED> <id> <side> <volume> <price> L\".\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId, char side,\n                      long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(),\n             orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\".\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s C %s %s\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    char buf[9];\n    // 4 chars of feed + 4-digit wrapping sequence -- see file header TODO\n    // on the known uniqueness limitation this carries.\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), (st.orderSeq++) % 10000);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs from what's\n// currently resting. Called both reactively (from onBBO/onMD, the instant\n// something that should move our price happens) and from a bounded\n// safety-net loop -- see file header on why both exist.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st) {\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    if (nowTp - st.lastRequote < cfg::kMinRequoteInterval) return;\n\n    DesiredQuote q = computeQuotes(st);\n\n    bool wantBid = q.haveBid;\n    bool needNewBid = wantBid && (st.restingBidId.empty() || st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx ||\n                                   st.restingBidRemaining != q.bidVol);\n    if (!wantBid && !st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n        std::string id = st.restingBidId;\n        st.restingBidId.clear();\n        st.restingBidPx = -1;\n        st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n    } else if (needNewBid) {\n        if (!st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n            std::string id = st.restingBidId;\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n        }\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'B', q.bidVol, q.bidPx)) {\n            st.restingBidId = id;\n            st.restingBidPx = q.bidPx;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = q.bidVol;\n        }\n    }\n\n    bool wantAsk = q.haveAsk;\n    bool needNewAsk = wantAsk && (st.restingAskId.empty() || st.restingAskPx != q.askPx ||\n                                   st.restingAskRemaining != q.askVol);\n    if (!wantAsk && !st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n        std::string id = st.restingAskId;\n        st.restingAskId.clear();\n        st.restingAskPx = -1;\n        st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n    } else if (needNewAsk) {\n        if (!st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n            std::string id = st.restingAskId;\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n        }\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'S', q.askVol, q.askPx)) {\n            st.restingAskId = id;\n            st.restingAskPx = q.askPx;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = q.askVol;\n        }\n    }\n\n    st.lastRequote = nowTp;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// PnL logging -- same column layout as before, for compatibility with\n// existing analysis scripts. \"pnl_since_recalib\" has no meaning in this\n// design (there's no recalibration concept any more) and is kept only as a\n// duplicate of total_pnl for format compatibility.\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void writePnlRow(const std::string& eventType, InstrumentState& st, const std::string& side,\n                         long long fillPrice, long long fillVolume, const std::string& counterparty,\n                         const std::string& role) {\n    double mid = fairValue(st);\n    double unrealized = 0.0;\n    if (st.position != 0) {\n        unrealized = (st.position > 0) ? ((mid - st.avgEntryPrice) * st.position)\n                                        : ((st.avgEntryPrice - mid) * (-st.position));\n    }\n    double total = st.realizedPnL + unrealized;\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> logLock(gLogMutex);\n    gPnlFile << nowNanos() << \",\" << eventType << \",\" << st.feed << \",\" << side << \",\" << fillPrice\n             << \",\" << fillVolume << \",\" << counterparty << \",\" << role << \",\" << st.position << \",\"\n             << st.avgEntryPrice << \",\" << mid << \",\" << st.meta.ref_price << \",\" << st.realizedPnL\n             << \",\" << unrealized << \",\" << total << \",\" << total << \"\\n\";\n    gPnlFile.flush();\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill application (running-average cost method -- see file header TODO)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char ourSide, long long price, long long volume) {\n    long long signedVol = (ourSide == 'B') ? volume : -volume;\n    long long newPosition = st.position + signedVol;\n\n    bool sameDirectionOrFlat =\n        (st.position >= 0 && signedVol > 0) || (st.position <= 0 && signedVol < 0) || st.position == 0;\n    if (sameDirectionOrFlat) {\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::llabs(st.position) + static_cast<double>(price) * volume;\n        st.avgEntryPrice = std::llabs(newPosition) > 0 ? totalCost / std::llabs(newPosition) : 0.0;\n    } else {\n        long long closingVol = std::min(std::llabs(signedVol), std::llabs(st.position));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0) ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n                                               : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        st.realizedPnL += pnlPerUnit * closingVol;\n        if (std::llabs(signedVol) > std::llabs(st.position)) {\n            // Flipped through zero -- remaining volume opens a new position.\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n    st.position = newPosition;\n\n    // Generic same-side fill-burst pause: getting filled on our BID means\n    // we're buying, so a burst of same-side fills pauses the BID (stop\n    // buying more), and vice versa for the ASK.\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    auto& times = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.bidFillTimes : st.askFillTimes;\n    times.push_back(nowTp);\n    while (!times.empty() && nowTp - times.front() > cfg::kFillBurstWindow) times.pop_front();\n    if (static_cast<int>(times.size()) >= cfg::kFillBurstThreshold) {\n        auto& pauseUntil = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.pauseBidUntil : st.pauseAskUntil;\n        pauseUntil = nowTp + cfg::kFillBurstCooldown;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Market data callbacks\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc;\n    (void)sub;\n    (void)closure;\n    std::string payload(natsMsg_GetData(msg), natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg));\n    auto fields = split(payload, ' ');\n    // <ts> <FEED> <bid_px> <bid_vol> <ask_px> <ask_vol>\n    if (fields.size() != 6) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    long long ts = std::atoll(fields[0].c_str());\n    std::string feed = fields[1];\n    auto parseOr = [](const std::string& s) -> long long {\n        return (s == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(s.c_str());\n    };\n    long long bidPx = parseOr(fields[2]);\n    long long bidVol = parseOr(fields[3]);\n    long long askPx = parseOr(fields[4]);\n    long long askVol = parseOr(fields[5]);\n\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n    auto it = gInstruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == gInstruments.end()) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    st.prevBidPx = st.bidPx;\n    st.prevAskPx = st.askPx;\n    st.bidPx = bidPx;\n    st.bidVol = bidVol;\n    st.askPx = askPx;\n    st.askVol = askVol;\n\n    double fv = fairValue(st);\n    st.midHistory.push_back({ts, fv});\n    while (st.midHistory.size() > cfg::kMidHistoryCap) st.midHistory.pop_front();\n\n    if (st.isPiggyback) {\n        tryRecoverRel(st);\n        requoteInstrument(st);\n    } else if (st.isDriver) {\n        // Any piggyback of this driver should reprice off the new fair\n        // value immediately rather than waiting for its own BBO to move.\n        for (auto& kv : gInstruments) {\n            if (kv.second.isPiggyback && kv.second.driverFeed == feed) {\n                requoteInstrument(kv.second);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\nstatic void onMD(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc;\n    (void)sub;\n    (void)closure;\n    std::string payload(natsMsg_GetData(msg), natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg));\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    auto fields = split(payload, ' ');\n    if (fields.size() < 2) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    std::string type = fields[1];\n\n    // Subject is \"ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>\" -- pull the feed from the subject\n    // rather than trusting the payload to repeat it.\n    std::string subj(subject);\n    auto firstDot = subj.find('.');\n    auto secondDot = subj.find('.', firstDot + 1);\n    auto thirdDot = subj.find('.', secondDot + 1);\n    if (secondDot == std::string::npos || thirdDot == std::string::npos) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    std::string feed = subj.substr(secondDot + 1, thirdDot - secondDot - 1);\n\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n    auto it = gInstruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == gInstruments.end()) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    if (type == \"A\") {\n        // <ts> A <id:17> <B|S> <volume> <price>\n        if (fields.size() != 6) {\n            natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n            return;\n        }\n        RestingOrder ord;\n        ord.sender = senderOf(fields[2]);\n        ord.side = fields[3][0];\n        ord.volume = std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n        ord.price = std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n        st.liveOrders[fields[2]] = ord;\n    } else if (type == \"C\") {\n        // <ts> C <id:17>\n        if (fields.size() != 3) {\n            natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n            return;\n        }\n        const std::string& id = fields[2];\n        st.liveOrders.erase(id);\n\n        // If this was our own resting order and we STILL have it tracked\n        // locally, the exchange removed it out from under us without us\n        // asking -- i.e. it just got fully filled. Our own cancel path\n        // clears the local id before sending the cancel request, so a C\n        // for an id we still track here can only mean this. React\n        // immediately instead of waiting for the safety-net tick -- this\n        // is the fix for the \"resting order stays stale after being\n        // filled\" gap found while diagnosing the previous strategy.\n        bool wasOurBid = !st.restingBidId.empty() && id == (gSender + \":\" + st.restingBidId);\n        bool wasOurAsk = !st.restingAskId.empty() && id == (gSender + \":\" + st.restingAskId);\n        if (wasOurBid) {\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        if (wasOurAsk) {\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        if (wasOurBid || wasOurAsk) {\n            st.lastRequote = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{}; That offset is deterministic and, once\n//     recovered, gives us an exact fair value with no statistical\n//     uncertainty -- a real edge, not a guess.\n//   - Nothing about symbol names, participant names, or instrument counts\n//     is hardcoded anywhere in this file. Every one of those is discovered\n//     at runtime from raw message traffic, because the task explicitly\n//     says the grading environment may have a different (implied: larger,\n//     unknown-N) instantiation of the same underlying behaviors. See the\n//     \"Discovery\" section below for exactly how that works.\n//   - No seat trades anything until at least one driver/piggyback pairing\n//     and its offset have been confirmed from data alone. Position that results from being\n//     crossed while quoting is a normal, transient byproduct of providing\n//     liquidity -- it is the (separate, Python) hedger's job to keep the\n//     desk's combined position low, promptly, per the task spec. Every few seconds, run a discovery pass:\n//        a. For every pair of instruments, search a small window of lags in\n//           both directions and take the best-fit (direction, lag, R^2) via\n//           correlation on the (possibly lag-shifted) fair-value series.\n//           High R^2 above a floor -> the pair is \"related\" (this only\n//           tells you cluster membership -- see next point for why it\n//           can't tell you direction).\n//        b. i < n; ++i) {\n        double dx = x[i] - mx, dy = y[i] - my;\n        sxy += dx * dy;\n        sxx += dx * dx;\n        syy += dy * dy;\n    }\n    if (sxx <= 0 || syy <= 0) return 0.0;\n    return sxy / std::sqrt(sxx * syy);\n}\n\n// Forward-fill lookup: the value of `hist` at-or-before time `ts`. `hist` is\n// append-only in time order, so a binary search over its (random-access)\n// deque iterators is valid.\nstatic bool valueAtOrBefore(const std::deque<std::pair<long long, double>>& hist, long long ts,\n                             double& out) {\n    if (hist.empty() || hist.front().first > ts) return false;\n    auto it = std::upper_bound(\n        hist.begin(), hist.end(), ts,\n        [](long long t, const std::pair<long long, double>& p) { return t < p.first; });\n    if (it == hist.begin()) return false;\n    --it;\n    out = it->second;\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Exchange's own fair-value definition (microprice, falling back to mid\n// when the spread is wide or a side is empty) -- generic, not tied to any\n// particular instrument.\nstatic double fairValue(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 && st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.meta.ref_price);\n    if (st.bidPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.askPx);\n    if (st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.bidPx);\n\n    long long tick = st.meta.ticksize > 0 ? st.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    long long spreadTicks = (st.askPx - st.bidPx) / tick;\n    if (spreadTicks >= 2 || st.bidVol <= 0 || st.askVol <= 0) {\n        return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n    }\n    return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) * st.askVol + static_cast<double>(st.askPx) * st.bidVol) /\n           static_cast<double>(st.bidVol + st.askVol);\n}\n\n// True if the resting order currently sitting at instrument `st`'s best\n// price on `side` ('B' or 'S') is owned by `sender`. Conservative: if we\n// can't positively identify an owner at that exact price, we return false\n// rather than block on a maybe -- callers combine this with other checks,\n// it isn't meant to be the sole gate.\nstatic bool bestPriceOwnedBy(const InstrumentState& st, char side, const std::string& sender) {\n    if (sender.empty()) return false;\n    long long px = (side == 'B') ? st.bidPx : st.askPx;\n    if (px < 0) return false;\n    for (const auto& kv : st.liveOrders) {\n        const RestingOrder& ord = kv.second;\n        if (ord.side == side && ord.price == px && ord.sender == sender) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Discovery: pairwise lagged correlation\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct PairFit {\n    double r2 = 0.0;\n    long long lag = 0;\n    bool aLeadsB = true;\n};\n\n// Tests both directions across a small lag grid and returns whichever\n// (direction, lag) combination fits best. \"A leads B at lag L\" means\n// B(t) ~ a + b * A(t - L) fits better than the reverse.\nstatic PairFit bestFit(const InstrumentState& a, const InstrumentState& b) {\n    PairFit best;\n    for (int dir = 0; dir < 2; ++dir) {\n        const auto& lead = (dir == 0) ? a.midHistory : b.midHistory;\n        const auto& lagging = (dir == 0) ? b.midHistory : a.midHistory;\n        for (long long lag = 0; lag <= cfg::kMaxLagNanos; lag += cfg::kLagStepNanos) {\n            std::vector<double> xs, ys;\n            xs.reserve(lagging.size());\n            ys.reserve(lagging.size());\n            for (const auto& p : lagging) {\n                double leadVal;\n                if (valueAtOrBefore(lead, p.first - lag, leadVal)) {\n                    xs.push_back(leadVal);\n                    ys.push_back(p.second);\n                }\n            }\n            if (static_cast<int>(xs.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) continue;\n            double r = pearsonR(xs, ys);\n            double r2 = r * r;\n            if (r2 > best.r2) {\n                best.r2 = r2;\n                best.lag = lag;\n                best.aLeadsB = (dir == 0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\n\n// Simple union-find over feed names.\nstruct UnionFind {\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> parent;\n    std::string find(const std::string& x) {\n        auto it = parent.find(x);\n        if (it == parent.end()) {\n            parent[x] = x;\n            return x;\n        }\n        if (it->second == x) return x;\n        std::string root = find(it->second);\n        parent[x] = root;\n        return root;\n    }\n    void unite(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {\n        std::string ra = find(a), rb = find(b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n};\n\nstatic void publishPairing(const std::string& piggyback, const std::string& driver, double rel) {\n    if (!gDeskKv) return;\n    std::ostringstream oss;\n    oss << \"driver=\" << driver << \";rel=\" << rel << \";ready=true\";\n    uint64_t rev = 0;\n    natsStatus s = kvStore_PutString(&rev, gDeskKv, piggyback.c_str(), oss.str().c_str());\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] failed to publish pairing to DESK_STATE: %s\\n\", piggyback.c_str(),\n               natsStatus_GetText(s));\n    }\n}\n\n// Called periodically. Builds the co-movement graph, clusters it, and\n// within each cluster identifies the driver by trade concentration --\n// see file header for why R^2 alone can't do this last part.\nstatic void runDiscoveryPass() {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> feeds;\n    feeds.reserve(gInstruments.size());\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) feeds.push_back(kv.first);\n\n    UnionFind uf;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < feeds.size(); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < feeds.size(); ++j) {\n            InstrumentState& A = gInstruments[feeds[i]];\n            InstrumentState& B = gInstruments[feeds[j]];\n            if (static_cast<int>(A.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints ||\n                static_cast<int>(B.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            PairFit f = bestFit(A, B);\n            if (f.r2 >= cfg::kR2Floor) {\n                uf.unite(feeds[i], feeds[j]);\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PAIR_RELATED,\" << feeds[i] << \"-\" << feeds[j]\n                                  << \",r2=\" << f.r2 << \";lag=\" << f.lag\n                                  << \";aLeadsB=\" << (f.aLeadsB ? 1 : 0) << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> components;\n    for (auto& feed : feeds) {\n        if (uf.parent.count(feed)) components[uf.find(feed)].push_back(feed);\n    }\n\n    for (auto& kv : components) {\n        std::vector<std::string>& members = kv.second;\n        if (members.size() < 2) continue;\n\n        std::string bestFeed, bestSender;\n        double bestFrac = 0.0;\n        int strongCount = 0;\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            InstrumentState& st = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (st.totalTrades < cfg::kTradeWarmup) continue;\n            std::string domSender;\n            long long domCount = 0;\n            for (auto& sc : st.senderTradeCount) {\n                if (sc.second > domCount) {\n                    domCount = sc.second;\n                    domSender = sc.first;\n                }\n            }\n            double frac = st.totalTrades > 0 ? static_cast<double>(domCount) / st.totalTrades : 0.0;\n            if (frac >= cfg::kDominanceFloor) {\n                strongCount++;\n                if (frac > bestFrac) {\n                    bestFrac = frac;\n                    bestFeed = feed;\n                    bestSender = domSender;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (strongCount != 1) {\n            // Either nobody's dominant enough yet (still gathering data) or\n            // more than one member looks driver-shaped (ambiguous) -- log\n            // and wait for more data rather than guess.\n            if (strongCount > 1 && gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER,\";\n                for (auto& f : members) gDiscoveryLog << f << \";\";\n                gDiscoveryLog << \"\\n\";\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        InstrumentState& driverSt = gInstruments[bestFeed];\n        if (!driverSt.isDriver) {\n            driverSt.isDriver = true;\n            driverSt.moverSender = bestSender;\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",DRIVER_IDENTIFIED,\" << bestFeed\n                              << \",mover=\" << bestSender << \";frac=\" << bestFrac << \"\\n\";\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            if (feed == bestFeed) continue;\n            InstrumentState& pig = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (pig.isDriver) continue;  // defensive; shouldn't happen given union-find semantics\n            if (!pig.isPiggyback) {\n                pig.isPiggyback = true;\n                pig.driverFeed = bestFeed;\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PIGGYBACK_IDENTIFIED,\" << feed\n                                  << \",driver=\" << bestFeed << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Rel recovery (piggyback offset against its driver)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Attempts to recover/refresh a piggyback's fixed offset against its\n// driver. Fires on a \"requote burst\" (both sides move together -- the live\n// signature of the background bot repricing), gated by the mover-ownership\n// contamination guard described in the file header.\nstatic void tryRecoverRel(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback) return;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    bool bothMoved = pig.prevBidPx >= 0 && pig.prevAskPx >= 0 && pig.bidPx >= 0 && pig.askPx >= 0 &&\n                      pig.bidPx != pig.prevBidPx && pig.askPx != pig.prevAskPx;\n    if (!bothMoved) return;\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender) || bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender)) {\n        // Contaminated: the level we'd sample from is the mover's own\n        // resting quote, not the LP's rule. Skip this sample entirely.\n        return;\n    }\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = (static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(pig.askPx)) / 2.0;\n    double sample = driverFv - center;\n\n    pig.relSamples.push_back(sample);\n    while (pig.relSamples.size() > cfg::kRelWindow) pig.relSamples.pop_front();\n\n    double halfSpread = (static_cast<double>(pig.askPx) - static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx)) / 2.0;\n    if (!pig.haveObservedHalfSpread) {\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = halfSpread;\n        pig.haveObservedHalfSpread = true;\n    } else {\n        constexpr double kEmaAlpha = 0.2;\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = kEmaAlpha * halfSpread + (1 - kEmaAlpha) * pig.observedHalfSpread;\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relSamples.size() < cfg::kRelMinSamples) return;\n\n    std::vector<double> v(pig.relSamples.begin(), pig.relSamples.end());\n    double m = meanOf(v);\n    double var = 0.0;\n    for (double x : v) var += (x - m) * (x - m);\n    var /= static_cast<double>(v.size());\n    double sd = std::sqrt(var);\n    long long driverTick = drv.meta.ticksize > 0 ? drv.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double sdTicks = sd / static_cast<double>(driverTick);\n\n    bool wasTrusted = pig.relTrusted;\n    if (sdTicks < cfg::kRelTrustStdTicks) {\n        pig.rel = m;\n        pig.relTrusted = true;\n    } else {\n        pig.relTrusted = false;\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relTrusted && !wasTrusted) {\n        publishPairing(pig.feed, pig.driverFeed, pig.rel);\n        if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n            gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",REL_TRUSTED,\" << pig.feed << \",driver=\" << pig.driverFeed\n                          << \";rel=\" << pig.rel << \";sdTicks=\" << sdTicks << \"\\n\";\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Quoting\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DesiredQuote {\n    bool haveBid = false, haveAsk = false;\n    long long bidPx = 0, askPx = 0;\n    long long bidVol = 0, askVol = 0;\n};\n\n// Drivers are never quoted -- see file header. Only piggybacks with a\n// trusted rel get quotes, priced off the driver's fair value plus that\n// fixed offset, a couple of ticks inside the LP's own observed spread.\nstatic DesiredQuote computeQuotes(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    DesiredQuote q;\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback || !pig.relTrusted) return q;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return q;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = driverFv + pig.rel;\n\n    long long tick = pig.meta.ticksize > 0 ? pig.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double insideBy =\n        std::max(static_cast<double>(tick), pig.observedHalfSpread - cfg::kQuoteInsideTicks * tick);\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center - insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center + insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n\n    long long size = std::max<long long>(pig.meta.min_volume, 1);\n    // TODO (see file header): size should scale with headroom against\n    // meta.position_limit and, eventually, the hedger's netted exposure.\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    bool bidPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseBidUntil;\n    bool askPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseAskUntil;\n    bool bidMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool askMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    if (!bidPaused && !bidMoverOwned) {\n        q.haveBid = true;\n        q.bidPx = bidPx;\n        q.bidVol = size;\n    }\n    if (!askPaused && !askMoverOwned) {\n        q.haveAsk = true;\n        q.askPx = askPx;\n        q.askVol = size;\n    }\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> A <FEED> <id> <side> <volume> <price> L\".\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId, char side,\n                      long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(),\n             orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\".\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s C %s %s\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    char buf[9];\n    // 4 chars of feed + 4-digit wrapping sequence -- see file header TODO\n    // on the known uniqueness limitation this carries.\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), (st.orderSeq++) % 10000);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs from what's\n// currently resting. Called both reactively (from onBBO/onMD, the instant\n// something that should move our price happens) and from a bounded\n// safety-net loop -- see file header on why both exist.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st) {\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    if (nowTp - st.lastRequote < cfg::kMinRequoteInterval) return;\n\n    DesiredQuote q = computeQuotes(st);\n\n    bool wantBid = q.haveBid;\n    bool needNewBid = wantBid && (st.restingBidId.empty() || st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx ||\n                                   st.restingBidRemaining != q.bidVol);\n    if (!wantBid && !st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n        std::string id = st.restingBidId;\n        st.restingBidId.clear();\n        st.restingBidPx = -1;\n        st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n    } else if (needNewBid) {\n        if (!st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n            std::string id = st.restingBidId;\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n        }\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'B', q.bidVol, q.bidPx)) {\n            st.restingBidId = id;\n            st.restingBidPx = q.bidPx;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = q.bidVol;\n        }\n    }\n\n    bool wantAsk = q.haveAsk;\n    bool needNewAsk = wantAsk && (st.restingAskId.empty() || st.restingAskPx != q.askPx ||\n                                   st.restingAskRemaining != q.askVol);\n    if (!wantAsk && !st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n        std::string id = st.restingAskId;\n        st.restingAskId.clear();\n        st.restingAskPx = -1;\n        st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n    } else if (needNewAsk) {\n        if (!st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n            std::string id = st.restingAskId;\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\n        }\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'S', q.askVol, q.askPx)) {\n            st.restingAskId = id;\n            st.restingAskPx = q.askPx;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = q.askVol;\n        }\n    }\n\n    st.lastRequote = nowTp;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// PnL logging -- same column layout as before, for compatibility with\n// existing analysis scripts. \"pnl_since_recalib\" has no meaning in this\n// design (there's no recalibration concept any more) and is kept only as a\n// duplicate of total_pnl for format compatibility.\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void writePnlRow(const std::string& eventType, InstrumentState& st, const std::string& side,\n                         long long fillPrice, long long fillVolume, const std::string& counterparty,\n                         const std::string& role) {\n    double mid = fairValue(st);\n    double unrealized = 0.0;\n    if (st.position != 0) {\n        unrealized = (st.position > 0) ? ((mid - st.avgEntryPrice) * st.position)\n                                        : ((st.avgEntryPrice - mid) * (-st.position));\n    }\n    double total = st.realizedPnL + unrealized;\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> logLock(gLogMutex);\n    gPnlFile << nowNanos() << \",\" << eventType << \",\" << st.feed << \",\" << side << \",\" << fillPrice\n             << \",\" << fillVolume << \",\" << counterparty << \",\" << role << \",\" << st.position << \",\"\n             << st.avgEntryPrice << \",\" << mid << \",\" << st.meta.ref_price << \",\" << st.realizedPnL\n             << \",\" << unrealized << \",\" << total << \",\" << total << \"\\n\";\n    gPnlFile.flush();\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill application (running-average cost method -- see file header TODO)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char ourSide, long long price, long long volume) {\n    long long signedVol = (ourSide == 'B') ? volume : -volume;\n    long long newPosition = st.position + signedVol;\n\n    bool sameDirectionOrFlat =\n        (st.position >= 0 && signedVol > 0) || (st.position <= 0 && signedVol < 0) || st.position == 0;\n    if (sameDirectionOrFlat) {\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::llabs(st.position) + static_cast<double>(price) * volume;\n        st.avgEntryPrice = std::llabs(newPosition) > 0 ? totalCost / std::llabs(newPosition) : 0.0;\n    } else {\n        long long closingVol = std::min(std::llabs(signedVol), std::llabs(st.position));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0) ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n                                               : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        st.realizedPnL += pnlPerUnit * closingVol;\n        if (std::llabs(signedVol) > std::llabs(st.position)) {\n            // Flipped through zero -- remaining volume opens a new position.\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n    st.position = newPosition;\n\n    // Generic same-side fill-burst pause: getting filled on our BID means\n    // we're buying, so a burst of same-side fills pauses the BID (stop\n    // buying more), and vice versa for the ASK.\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    auto& times = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.bidFillTimes : st.askFillTimes;\n    times.push_back(nowTp);\n    while (!times.empty() && nowTp - times.front() > cfg::kFillBurstWindow) times.pop_front();\n    if (static_cast<int>(times.size()) >= cfg::kFillBurstThreshold) {\n        auto& pauseUntil = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.pauseBidUntil : st.pauseAskUntil;\n        pauseUntil = nowTp + cfg::kFillBurstCooldown;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Market data callbacks\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc;\n    (void)sub;\n    (void)closure;\n    std::string payload(natsMsg_GetData(msg),         // rolling sample window\\nconstexpr size_t kRelMinSamples = 6;      // bare statistical minimum before trusting a mean at all\\nconstexpr double kRelTrustStdTicks = 2.0; // trust once sample stddev is this tight (in driver ticks)\\n\\n// -- quoting --\\nconstexpr int kQuoteInsideTicks = 2;      // how far inside the LP's own spread we sit, once trusted\\nconst std::chrono::milliseconds kMinRequoteInterval{100};  // crude per-instrument max_tps guard\\nconst std::chrono::milliseconds kSafetyNetInterval{100};\\n\\n// -- defensive same-side fill-burst pause (generic backstop) --\\nconstexpr int kFillBurstThreshold = 2;\\nconst std::chrono::milliseconds kFillBurstWindow{250};\\nconst std::chrono::milliseconds kFillBurstCooldown{2000};\\n}  // namespace cfg\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Per-instrument state\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\n// Who currently owns a resting order, keyed by the public \\\"sender:orderid\\\"\\n// id. Rebuilt live from A/C market-data messages -- this is how we answer\\n// \\\"is a specific sender currently resting on top of this book\\\" without\\n// hardcoding who that sender is.\\nstruct RestingOrder {\\n    std::string sender;\\n    char side = ' ';\\n    long long volume = 0;\\n    long long price = 0;\\n};\\n\\nstruct InstrumentState {\\n    std::string feed;\\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\\n\\n    // -- live book state, from ex.bbo.<FEED> --\\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\\n    long long prevBidPx = -1, prevAskPx = -1;\\n\\n    // -- raw fair-value history for discovery's pairwise lag search --\\n    std::deque<std::pair<long long, double>> midHistory;  // (ts, fair value)\\n\\n    // -- per-sender trade counts, for driver/mover identification --\\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, long long> senderTradeCount;\\n    long long totalTrades = 0;\\n\\n    // -- live resting-order ownership, from A/C messages, ANY sender --\\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, RestingOrder> liveOrders;  // key: \\\"sender:orderid\\\"\\n\\n    // -- discovery outcome --\\n    bool isDriver = false;\\n    bool isPiggyback = false;\\n    std::string driverFeed;   // valid if isPiggyback\\n    std::string moverSender;  // valid if isDriver: the dominant sender found for this instrument\\n    std::deque<double> relSamples;\\n    double rel = 0.0;\\n    bool relTrusted = false;\\n    double observedHalfSpread = 0.0;  // EMA of the LP's own half-spread, once we're sampling cleanly\\n    bool haveObservedHalfSpread = false;\\n\\n    // -- our own resting orders --\\n    std::string restingBidId, restingAskId;\\n    long long restingBidPx = -1, restingAskPx = -1;\\n    long long restingBidRemaining = 0, restingAskRemaining = 0;\\n    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastRequote{};\\n\\n    // -- position / PnL (running-average cost method -- see file header) --\\n    long long position = 0;\\n    double avgEntryPrice = 0.0;\\n    double realizedPnL = 0.0;\\n    std::set<std::string> seenMatchIds;\\n\\n    // -- generic same-side fill-burst pause (defensive backstop) --\\n    std::deque<std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point> bidFillTimes, askFillTimes;\\n    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point pauseBidUntil{}, pauseAskUntil{};\\n\\n    long long orderSeq = 0;\\n};\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Global state\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstatic natsConnection* gConn = nullptr;\\nstatic std::string gSender;\\nstatic kvStore* gDeskKv = nullptr;  // \\\"DESK_STATE\\\" bucket -- published for the hedger\\n\\nstatic std::map<std::string, InstrumentState> gInstruments;\\nstatic std::mutex gMutex;  // protects gInstruments end-to-end; see header TODO on locking\\n\\nstatic std::ofstream gPnlFile;\\nstatic std::mutex gLogMutex;\\nstatic std::ofstream gDiscoveryLog;\\n\\nstatic std::atomic<bool> gRunning{true};\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Math helpers\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstatic double meanOf(const std::vector<double>& v) {\\n    if (v.empty()) return 0.0;\\n    return std::accumulate(v.begin(), v.end(), 0.0) / static_cast<double>(v.size());\\n}\\n\\nstatic double pearsonR(const std::vector<double>& x, const std::vector<double>& y) {\\n    size_t n = x.size();\\n    if (n < 2 || y.size() != n) return 0.0;\\n    double mx = meanOf(x), my = meanOf(y);\\n    double sxy = 0, sxx = 0, syy = 0;\\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        double dx = x[i] - mx, dy = y[i] - my;\\n        sxy += dx * dy;\\n        sxx += dx * dx;\\n        syy += dy * dy;\\n    }\\n    if (sxx <= 0 || syy <= 0) return 0.0;\\n    return sxy / std::sqrt(sxx * syy);\\n}\\n\\n// Forward-fill lookup: the value of `hist` at-or-before time `ts`. `hist` is\\n// append-only in time order, so a binary search over its (random-access)\\n// deque iterators is valid.\\nstatic bool valueAtOrBefore(const std::deque<std::pair<long long, double>>& hist, long long ts,\\n                             double& out) {\\n    if (hist.empty() || hist.front().first > ts) return false;\\n    auto it = std::upper_bound(\\n        hist.begin(), hist.end(), ts,\\n        [](long long t, const std::pair<long long, double>& p) { return t < p.first; });\\n    if (it == hist.begin()) return false;\\n    --it;\\n    out = it->second;\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\n// Exchange's own fair-value definition (microprice, falling back to mid\\n// when the spread is wide or a side is empty) -- generic, not tied to any\\n// particular instrument.\\nstatic double fairValue(const InstrumentState& st) {\\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 && st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.meta.ref_price);\\n    if (st.bidPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.askPx);\\n    if (st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.bidPx);\\n\\n    long long tick = st.meta.ticksize > 0 ? st.meta.ticksize : 1;\\n    long long spreadTicks = (st.askPx - st.bidPx) / tick;\\n    if (spreadTicks >= 2 || st.bidVol <= 0 || st.askVol <= 0) {\\n        return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\\n    }\\n    return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) * st.askVol + static_cast<double>(st.askPx) * st.bidVol) /\\n           static_cast<double>(st.bidVol + st.askVol);\\n}\\n\\n// True if the resting order currently sitting at instrument `st`'s best\\n// price on `side` ('B' or 'S') is owned by `sender`. Conservative: if we\\n// can't positively identify an owner at that exact price, we return false\\n// rather than block on a maybe -- callers combine this with other checks,\\n// it isn't meant to be the sole gate.\\nstatic bool bestPriceOwnedBy(const InstrumentState& st, char side, const std::string& sender) {\\n    if (sender.empty()) return false;\\n    long long px = (side == 'B') ? st.bidPx : st.askPx;\\n    if (px < 0) return false;\\n    for (const auto& kv : st.liveOrders) {\\n        const RestingOrder& ord = kv.second;\\n        if (ord.side == side && ord.price == px && ord.sender == sender) return true;\\n    }\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Discovery: pairwise lagged correlation\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstruct PairFit {\\n    double r2 = 0.0;\\n    long long lag = 0;\\n    bool aLeadsB = true;\\n};\\n\\n// Tests both directions across a small lag grid and returns whichever\\n// (direction, lag) combination fits best. \\\"A leads B at lag L\\\" means\\n// B(t) ~ a + b * A(t - L) fits better than the reverse.\\nstatic PairFit bestFit(const InstrumentState& a, const InstrumentState& b) {\\n    PairFit best;\\n    for (int dir = 0; dir < 2; ++dir) {\\n        const auto& lead = (dir == 0) ? a.midHistory : b.midHistory;\\n        const auto& lagging = (dir == 0) ? b.midHistory : a.midHistory;\\n        for (long long lag = 0; lag <= cfg::kMaxLagNanos; lag += cfg::kLagStepNanos) {\\n            std::vector<double> xs, ys;\\n            xs.reserve(lagging.size());\\n            ys.reserve(lagging.size());\\n            for (const auto& p : lagging) {\\n                double leadVal;\\n                if (valueAtOrBefore(lead, p.first - lag, leadVal)) {\\n                    xs.push_back(leadVal);\\n                    ys.push_back(p.second);\\n                }\\n            }\\n            if (static_cast<int>(xs.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) continue;\\n            double r = pearsonR(xs, ys);\\n            double r2 = r * r;\\n            if (r2 > best.r2) {\\n                best.r2 = r2;\\n                best.lag = lag;\\n                best.aLeadsB = (dir == 0);\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    return best;\\n}\\n\\n// Simple union-find over feed names.\\nstruct UnionFind {\\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> parent;\\n    std::string find(const std::string& x) {\\n        auto it = parent.find(x);\\n        if (it == parent.end()) {\\n            parent[x] = x;\\n            return x;\\n        }\\n        if (it->second == x) return x;\\n        std::string root = find(it->second);\\n        parent[x] = root;\\n        return root;\\n    }\\n    void unite(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {\\n        std::string ra = find(a), rb = find(b);\\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\\n    }\\n};\\n\\nstatic void publishPairing(const std::string& piggyback, const std::string& driver, double rel) {\\n    if (!gDeskKv) return;\\n    std::ostringstream oss;\\n    oss << \\\"driver=\\\" << driver << \\\";rel=\\\" << rel << \\\";ready=true\\\";\\n    uint64_t rev = 0;\\n    natsStatus s = kvStore_PutString(&rev, gDeskKv, piggyback.c_str(), oss.str().c_str());\\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\\n        printf(\\\"[%s] failed to publish pairing to DESK_STATE: %s\\\\n\\\", piggyback.c_str(),\\n               natsStatus_GetText(s));\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// Called periodically. Builds the co-movement graph, clusters it, and\\n// within each cluster identifies the driver by trade concentration --\\n// see file header for why R^2 alone can't do this last part.\\nstatic void runDiscoveryPass() {\\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\\n\\n    std::vector<std::string> feeds;\\n    feeds.reserve(gInstruments.size());\\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) feeds.push_back(kv.first);\\n\\n    UnionFind uf;\\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < feeds.size(); ++i) {\\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < feeds.size(); ++j) {\\n            InstrumentState& A = gInstruments[feeds[i]];\\n            InstrumentState& B = gInstruments[feeds[j]];\\n            if (static_cast<int>(A.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints ||\\n                static_cast<int>(B.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) {\\n                continue;\\n            }\\n            PairFit f = bestFit(A, B);\\n            if (f.r2 >= cfg::kR2Floor) {\\n                uf.unite(feeds[i], feeds[j]);\\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \\\",PAIR_RELATED,\\\" << feeds[i] << \\\"-\\\" << feeds[j]\\n                                  << \\\",r2=\\\" << f.r2 << \\\";lag=\\\" << f.lag\\n                                  << \\\";aLeadsB=\\\" << (f.aLeadsB ? 1 : 0) << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> components;\\n    for (auto& feed : feeds) {\\n        if (uf.parent.count(feed)) components[uf.find(feed)].push_back(feed);\\n    }\\n\\n    for (auto& kv : components) {\\n        std::vector<std::string>& members = kv.second;\\n        if (members.size() < 2) continue;\\n\\n        std::string bestFeed, bestSender;\\n        double bestFrac = 0.0;\\n        int strongCount = 0;\\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\\n            InstrumentState& st = gInstruments[feed];\\n            if (st.totalTrades < cfg::kTradeWarmup) continue;\\n            std::string domSender;\\n            long long domCount = 0;\\n            for (auto& sc : st.senderTradeCount) {\\n                if (sc.second > domCount) {\\n                    domCount = sc.second;\\n                    domSender = sc.first;\\n                }\\n            }\\n            double frac = st.totalTrades > 0 ? static_cast<double>(domCount) / st.totalTrades : 0.0;\\n            if (frac >= cfg::kDominanceFloor) {\\n                strongCount++;\\n                if (frac > bestFrac) {\\n                    bestFrac = frac;\\n                    bestFeed = feed;\\n                    bestSender = domSender;\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        if (strongCount != 1) {\\n            // Either nobody's dominant enough yet (still gathering data) or\\n            // more than one member looks driver-shaped (ambiguous) -- log\\n            // and wait for more data rather than guess.\\n            if (strongCount > 1 && gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \\\",AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER,\\\";\\n                for (auto& f : members) gDiscoveryLog << f << \\\";\\\";\\n                gDiscoveryLog << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n            }\\n            continue;\\n        }\\n\\n        InstrumentState& driverSt = gInstruments[bestFeed];\\n        if (!driverSt.isDriver) {\\n            driverSt.isDriver = true;\\n            driverSt.moverSender = bestSender;\\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \\\",DRIVER_IDENTIFIED,\\\" << bestFeed\\n                              << \\\",mover=\\\" << bestSender << \\\";frac=\\\" << bestFrac << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\\n            if (feed == bestFeed) continue;\\n            InstrumentState& pig = gInstruments[feed];\\n            if (pig.isDriver) continue;  // defensive; shouldn't happen given union-find semantics\\n            if (!pig.isPiggyback) {\\n                pig.isPiggyback = true;\\n                pig.driverFeed = bestFeed;\\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \\\",PIGGYBACK_IDENTIFIED,\\\" << feed\\n                                  << \\\",driver=\\\" << bestFeed << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Rel recovery (piggyback offset against its driver)\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\n// Attempts to recover/refresh a piggyback's fixed offset against its\\n// driver. Fires on a \\\"requote burst\\\" (both sides move together -- the live\\n// signature of the background bot repricing), gated by the mover-ownership\\n// contamination guard described in the file header.\\nstatic void tryRecoverRel(InstrumentState& pig) {\\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback) return;\\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return;\\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\\n\\n    bool bothMoved = pig.prevBidPx >= 0 && pig.prevAskPx >= 0 && pig.bidPx >= 0 && pig.askPx >= 0 &&\\n                      pig.bidPx != pig.prevBidPx && pig.askPx != pig.prevAskPx;\\n    if (!bothMoved) return;\\n\\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender) || bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender)) {\\n        // Contaminated: the level we'd sample from is the mover's own\\n        // resting quote, not the LP's rule. Skip this sample entirely.\\n        return;\\n    }\\n\\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\\n    double center = (static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(pig.askPx)) / 2.0;\\n    double sample = driverFv - center;\\n\\n    pig.relSamples.push_back(sample);\\n    while (pig.relSamples.size() > cfg::kRelWindow) pig.relSamples.pop_front();\\n\\n    double halfSpread = (static_cast<double>(pig.askPx) - static_cast<double>(pig.bidPx)) / 2.0;\\n    if (!pig.haveObservedHalfSpread) {\\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = halfSpread;\\n        pig.haveObservedHalfSpread = true;\\n    } else {\\n        constexpr double kEmaAlpha = 0.2;\\n        pig.observedHalfSpread = kEmaAlpha * halfSpread + (1 - kEmaAlpha) * pig.observedHalfSpread;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (pig.relSamples.size() < cfg::kRelMinSamples) return;\\n\\n    std::vector<double> v(pig.relSamples.begin(), pig.relSamples.end());\\n    double m = meanOf(v);\\n    double var = 0.0;\\n    for (double x : v) var += (x - m) * (x - m);\\n    var /= static_cast<double>(v.size());\\n    double sd = std::sqrt(var);\\n    long long driverTick = drv.meta.ticksize > 0 ? drv.meta.ticksize : 1;\\n    double sdTicks = sd / static_cast<double>(driverTick);\\n\\n    bool wasTrusted = pig.relTrusted;\\n    if (sdTicks < cfg::kRelTrustStdTicks) {\\n        pig.rel = m;\\n        pig.relTrusted = true;\\n    } else {\\n        pig.relTrusted = false;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (pig.relTrusted && !wasTrusted) {\\n        publishPairing(pig.feed, pig.driverFeed, pig.rel);\\n        if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\\n            gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \\\",REL_TRUSTED,\\\" << pig.feed << \\\",driver=\\\" << pig.driverFeed\\n                          << \\\";rel=\\\" << pig.rel << \\\";sdTicks=\\\" << sdTicks << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Quoting\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstruct DesiredQuote {\\n    bool haveBid = false, haveAsk = false;\\n    long long bidPx = 0, askPx = 0;\\n    long long bidVol = 0, askVol = 0;\\n};\\n\\n// Drivers are never quoted -- see file header. Only piggybacks with a\\n// trusted rel get quotes, priced off the driver's fair value plus that\\n// fixed offset, a couple of ticks inside the LP's own observed spread.\\nstatic DesiredQuote computeQuotes(InstrumentState& pig) {\\n    DesiredQuote q;\\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback || !pig.relTrusted) return q;\\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return q;\\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\\n\\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\\n    double center = driverFv + pig.rel;\\n\\n    long long tick = pig.meta.ticksize > 0 ? pig.meta.ticksize : 1;\\n    double insideBy =\\n        std::max(static_cast<double>(tick), pig.observedHalfSpread - cfg::kQuoteInsideTicks * tick);\\n\\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center - insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround((center + insideBy) / tick)) * tick;\\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\\n\\n    long long size = std::max<long long>(pig.meta.min_volume, 1);\\n    // TODO (see file header): size should scale with headroom against\\n    // meta.position_limit and, eventually, the hedger's netted exposure.\\n\\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\\n    bool bidPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseBidUntil;\\n    bool askPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseAskUntil;\\n    bool bidMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\\n    bool askMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\\n\\n    if (!bidPaused && !bidMoverOwned) {\\n        q.haveBid = true;\\n        q.bidPx = bidPx;\\n        q.bidVol = size;\\n    }\\n    if (!askPaused && !askMoverOwned) {\\n        q.haveAsk = true;\\n        q.askPx = askPx;\\n        q.askVol = size;\\n    }\\n    return q;\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Order entry\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\n// Sends \\\"<SENDER> A <FEED> <id> <side> <volume> <price> L\\\".\\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId, char side,\\n                      long long volume, long long price) {\\n    char msg[256];\\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \\\"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\\\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(),\\n             orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\\n    char subject[64];\\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \\\"ex.req.%s\\\", gSender.c_str());\\n\\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\\n        printf(\\\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\\\n\\\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\\n    printf(\\\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\\\n\\\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\\n    return false;\\n}\\n\\n// Sends \\\"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\\\".\\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\\n    char msg[256];\\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \\\"%s C %s %s\\\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\\n    char subject[64];\\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \\\"ex.req.%s\\\", gSender.c_str());\\n\\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\\n        printf(\\\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\\\n\\\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\\n}\\n\\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\\n    char buf[9];\\n    // 4 chars of feed + 4-digit wrapping sequence -- see file header TODO\\n    // on the known uniqueness limitation this carries.\\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \\\"%.4s%04lld\\\", st.feed.c_str(), (st.orderSeq++) % 10000);\\n    return std::string(buf);\\n}\\n\\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs from what's\\n// currently resting. Called both reactively (from onBBO/onMD, the instant\\n// something that should move our price happens) and from a bounded\\n// safety-net loop -- see file header on why both exist.\\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st) {\\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\\n    if (nowTp - st.lastRequote < cfg::kMinRequoteInterval) return;\\n\\n    DesiredQuote q = computeQuotes(st);\\n\\n    bool wantBid = q.haveBid;\\n    bool needNewBid = wantBid && (st.restingBidId.empty() || st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx ||\\n                                   st.restingBidRemaining != q.bidVol);\\n    if (!wantBid && !st.restingBidId.empty()) {\\n        std::string id = st.restingBidId;\\n        st.restingBidId.clear();\\n        st.restingBidPx = -1;\\n        st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\\n    } else if (needNewBid) {\\n        if (!st.restingBidId.empty()) {\\n            std::string id = st.restingBidId;\\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\\n        }\\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'B', q.bidVol, q.bidPx)) {\\n            st.restingBidId = id;\\n            st.restingBidPx = q.bidPx;\\n            st.restingBidRemaining = q.bidVol;\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    bool wantAsk = q.haveAsk;\\n    bool needNewAsk = wantAsk && (st.restingAskId.empty() || st.restingAskPx != q.askPx ||\\n                                   st.restingAskRemaining != q.askVol);\\n    if (!wantAsk && !st.restingAskId.empty()) {\\n        std::string id = st.restingAskId;\\n        st.restingAskId.clear();\\n        st.restingAskPx = -1;\\n        st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\\n    } else if (needNewAsk) {\\n        if (!st.restingAskId.empty()) {\\n            std::string id = st.restingAskId;\\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\\n            cancelOrder(st.feed, id);\\n        }\\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'S', q.askVol, q.askPx)) {\\n            st.restingAskId = id;\\n            st.restingAskPx = q.askPx;\\n            st.restingAskRemaining = q.askVol;\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    st.lastRequote = nowTp;\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// PnL logging -- same column layout as E.g.:\n```\nskew = position / position_limit  // in [-1, 1]\nyour_bid = mid - N*tick - skew*K*tick\nyour_ask = mid + N*tick - skew*K*tick\n```\nSo if you're long, both quotes shift down \u2014 you become less eager to buy more, more eager to sell. This is the one thing that actually protects you risk-wise and it's cheap to add.\n\n5. **Requote trigger**: don't requote on every BBO tick (spam + max_tps risk). Requote only when mid moves more than some threshold (e.g. 1 tick) since your last quote, or every fixed interval, whichever is simpler to implement first \u2014 time-based is easier to reason about for v1.\n\n6. **No inventory limit breach**: hard-stop adding to a side if position is already within some buffer of `position_limit` \u2014 pull that side's quote entirely rather than relying on skew alone.\n\nThat's the whole v1: mid from BBO (fallback ref_price), fixed spread, skewed by position, fixed size, time-gated requote, hard position cap.                         "extracted_content": "# Exchange protocol v2.5\n\nThe exchange speaks **space-separated ASCII messages over NATS**. Fields never\ncontain spaces. There are three things to talk to:\n\n| What                 | NATS subject              | Mechanism            |\n|----------------------|---------------------------|----------------------|\n| Order entry          | `ex.req.<SENDER>`         | request / reply      |\n| Market data          | `ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>`   | publish (JetStream)  |\n| Best bid/offer       | `ex.bbo.<FEED>`           | publish (JetStream)  |\n| Instrument metadata  | KV bucket `EX_META`       | JetStream KV         |\n\n- A **`<FEED>`** (feedcode) is 4 chars: 2 for the underlying + 2 for the expiry,\n  e.g. `AAH6`. All feedcodes on the same underlying share the prefix (`AA`).\n- A **`<SENDER>`** is an 8-char identity tag you choose for your strategy.\n- An **order id** is 8 chars you choose, unique per sender. Publicly an order is\n  identified by the 17-char `sender:orderid`.\n- Prices and volumes are integers.\n\n## Order entry \u2014 `ex.req.<SENDER>` (request/reply)\n\nPublish your request to **`ex.req.<your-sender>`** (NATS request/reply; the reply\ncomes back on the inbox). The sender in the subject is what the exchange acts on,\nand it **must match** the `<SENDER>` at the start of your message \u2014 you can only\nenter and cancel orders for your own sender. Every request starts with your\n`<SENDER>` then a 1-char type.\n\n| Type | Meaning      | Fields after `<SENDER> <type>`                                   |\n|------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|\n| `A`  | add order    | `<FEED> <id:8> <B\\|S> <volume> <price> <M\\|L\\|F>`                 |\n| `C`  | cancel order | `<FEED> <id:8>`                                                  |\n| `X`  | cancel many  | `<FEED> <B\\|S\\|X> <price>`  \u2014 see below                           |\n| `Q`  | enable STP   | `<FEED>`                                                         |\n| `W`  | disable STP  | `<FEED>`                                                          |\n\nOrder types: **`L`** = limit (rests on the book), **`M`** = market, **`F`** =\nfill-and-kill (executes what it can immediately, cancels the rest). Only `L`\nrests.\n\n**Replies** start with the exchange's tag, then:\n- `Y <n>` \u2014 accepted. For `A`, `<n>` is the volume that traded immediately. For\n  `C`/`X`, `<n>` is how many orders were cancelled.\n- `N <code> <text>` \u2014 rejected.\n\nReject codes are stable numbers with a short text. A few you will hit early:\n`100` malformed \u00b7 `202` bad feedcode \u00b7 `203` re-used order id. The rest are\nyours to catalogue by experiment.\n\n### `X` \u2014 cancel many\n\n`X <FEED> <B|S|X> <price>` cancels several of **your** resting orders at once and\nreplies `Y <n>` with the number cancelled. The `<FEED>` may also select more than\none expiry, price may select more than one price\n\n## Market data \u2014 `ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>`\n\nSubscribe to `ex.md.<FEED>.*` to see all market data for a contract, or to\n`ex.md.<FEED>.<your-sender>` for just your own. Every message is prefixed with an\n`int64` nanosecond timestamp.\n\n| Type | Fields after `<ts> <type>`                                          |\n|------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|\n| `A`  | `<id:17> <B\\|S> <volume> <price>`  \u2014 order added to the book          |\n| `E`  | `<incoming:17> <resting:17> <volume> <price> <matchid> <B\\|S>`        |\n| `C`  | `<id:17>`  \u2014 order removed from the book                              |\n| `T`  | same fields as `E`                                                    |\n\n- `E` is an **execution**. The trailing `B`/`S` is the **aggressor's side**. An\n  order may fill over **several** `E` messages \u2014 accumulate them.\n- `T` reports a **trade** \u2014 useful for watching trade flow.\n- Your own fills show up on `ex.md.<FEED>.<your-sender>`.\n\n## Best bid/offer \u2014 `ex.bbo.<FEED>`\n\n`<ts> <FEED> <bid_px> <bid_vol> <ask_px> <ask_vol>`, with `-` for an empty side.\nUpdated as the top of book changes.\n\n## Instrument metadata \u2014 KV `EX_META`\n\nKey = feedcode; value is `key=value` pairs: `ticksize`, `ref_price`, `band`\n(price band is `ref_price \u00b1 band`), `min_volume`, `max_volume`, `position_limit`,\n`max_tps`, `last_traded_price`. Read it to learn each contract's tick, price\nband, and limits.\n\n```bash\nnats kv ls  EX_META\nnats kv get EX_META AAH6\n```\n\n## Probing\n\nThe `nats` CLI is the fastest way to explore before you write code: `nats sub`\non the feeds above, `nats req` for order entry, `nats kv` for `EX_META`.\n"

<mutex>\n\n// Reads env var with a fallback default, since the grading harness injects\n// real values but local dev needs something sane.\nstatic const char* envOr(const char* name, const char* onMD write to the same ofstream, so writes must be\n// serialized or lines will interleave/corrupt.\nstruct LogTarget {\n    std::ofstream* file;\n    std::mutex* mtx;\n};\n\n// Splits a std::vector<std::string> fields;\n    std::string word;\n    while (ss >> word) {\n        fields.push_back(word);\n    }\n    return fields;\n}\n\n// Writes one CSV row: \"<source_tag>,<field0>,<field1>,...\".\n// source_tag distinguishes BBO rows from MD rows (which vary in arity\n// depending on message type A/C/E/T) so both can share one file.\nstatic void writeRow(LogTarget* target, const char* sourceTag,\n                      const std::vector<std::string>& fields) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(*target->mtx);\n    *target->file << sourceTag;\n    for (const auto& f : fields) {\n        *target->file << \",\" << f;\n    }\n    *target->file << \"\\n\";\n    target->file->flush();\n}\n\n// Called for every message on natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// Called for every message on ex.md.<FEED>.* (all senders).\n// Payload: \"<ts> <type> ...\", type in {A, C, E, T} \u2014 see PROTOCOL.md.\n//   A: <id:17> <B|S> <volume> fields.insert(fields.begin(), subject);\n    writeRow(target, \"MD\", fields);\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    std::ofstream file(\"/data/bbo_data.csv\");\n    std::mutex fileMutex;\n    LogTarget target{&file, &fileMutex};\n\n    if (!file.is_open()) {\n        std::cerr << \"Error!
