                            "file_text": "// skeleton.cpp\n//\n// Multi-instrument pipeline for the quoter (strategy/) seat:\n//   1. Connect to NATS at $NATS_URL\n//   2. Discover every instrument in EX_META (not a single hardcoded feed) \u2014\n//      the grading market's instrument set is deliberately unspecified, so\n//      we don't assume it looks like the sample's AAH6/AAM6/AAU6.\n//   3. Parse each instrument's EX_META metadata into a per-instrument state\n//      struct, kept in a map keyed by feedcode.\n//   4. Subscribe to ex.bbo.<FEED> and ex.md.<FEED>.* for every discovered\n//      feed; callbacks update that feed's own state and log to CSV.\n//\n// Still no order entry / quoting logic \u2014 this is the discovery + state\n// scaffolding that the actual strategy gets built on top of next.\n//\n// Build: see CMakeLists.txt / Dockerfile.\n\n#include <nats.h>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <fstream>\n#include <vector>\n#include <map>\n#include <string>\n#include <iostream>\n#include <sstream>\n#include <mutex>\n\n// Reads env var with a fallback default, since the grading harness injects\n// real values but local dev needs something sane.\nstatic const char* envOr(const char* name, const char* fallback) {\n    const char* v = std::getenv(name);\n    return (v && v[0] != '\\0') ? v : fallback;\n}\n\n// --- Per-instrument metadata, parsed from EX_META's \"key=value ...\" value ---\nstruct InstrumentMeta {\n    long long ticksize = 0;\n    long long ref_price = 0;\n    long long band = 0;\n    long long min_volume = 0;\n    long long max_volume = 0;\n    long long position_limit = 0;\n    long long max_tps = 0;\n    long long last_traded_price = 0;\n};\n\n// Parses \"ticksize=1 ref_price=600 band=5000 ...\" into an InstrumentMeta.\n// Unknown keys are ignored; missing keys stay at their default (0).\nstatic InstrumentMeta parseMeta(const std::string& value) {\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n    std::stringstream ss(value);\n    std::string pair;\n    while (ss >> pair) {\n        auto eq = pair.find('=');\n        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;\n        std::string key = pair.substr(0, eq);\n        long long val = std::atoll(pair.substr(eq + 1).c_str());\n        if (key == \"ticksize\") meta.ticksize = val;\n        else if (key == \"ref_price\") meta.ref_price = val;\n        else if (key == \"band\") meta.band = val;\n        else if (key == \"min_volume\") meta.min_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_volume\") meta.max_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"position_limit\") meta.position_limit = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_tps\") meta.max_tps = val;\n        else if (key == \"last_traded_price\") meta.last_traded_price = val;\n    }\n    return meta;\n}\n\n// --- Per-instrument live state, updated by the BBO/MD callbacks ---\nstruct InstrumentState {\n    std::string feed;\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n\n    // Latest BBO snapshot. -1 means \"no quote on that side\" (protocol uses\n    // \"-\" for an empty side).\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\n\n    // Position tracking is a placeholder until order entry exists: this\n    // wildcard MD subscription sees every sender's fills, not just ours, so\n    // there's no \"our position\" to compute yet. Discover every instrument in EX_META (not a single hardcoded feed) \u2014\n//      the grading market's instrument set is deliberately unspecified, so\n//      we don't assume it looks like the sample's AAH6/AAM6/AAU6.\n//   3. Parse each instrument's EX_META metadata into a per-instrument state\n//      struct, kept in a map keyed by feedcode.\n//   4. Subscribe to ex.bbo.<FEED> and ex.md.<FEED>.* for every discovered\n//      feed; callbacks update that feed's own state and log to CSV.\n//\n// Still no order entry / quoting logic \u2014 this is the discovery + state\n// scaffolding that the actual strategy gets built on top of next.\n//\n// Build: see CMakeLists.txt / Dockerfile.\n\n#include <nats.h>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <fstream>\n#include <vector>\n#include <map>\n#include <string>\n#include <iostream>\n#include <sstream>\n#include <mutex>\n\n// Reads env var with a fallback default, since the grading harness injects\n// real values but local dev needs something sane.\nstatic const char* envOr(const char* name, const char* fallback) {\n    const char* v = std::getenv(name);\n    return (v && v[0] != '\\0') ? v : fallback;\n}\n\n// --- Per-instrument metadata, parsed from EX_META's \"key=value ...\" value ---\nstruct InstrumentMeta {\n    long long ticksize = 0;\n    long long ref_price = 0;\n    long long band = 0;\n    long long min_volume = 0;\n    long long max_volume = 0;\n    long long position_limit = 0;\n    long long max_tps = 0;\n    long long last_traded_price = 0;\n};\n\n// Parses \"ticksize=1 ref_price=600 band=5000 ...\" into an InstrumentMeta.\n// Unknown keys are ignored; missing keys stay at their default (0).\nstatic InstrumentMeta parseMeta(const std::string& value) {\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n    std::stringstream ss(value);\n    std::string pair;\n    while (ss >> pair) {\n        auto eq = pair.find('=');\n        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;\n        std::string key = pair.substr(0, eq);\n        long long val = std::atoll(pair.substr(eq + 1).c_str());\n        if (key == \"ticksize\") meta.ticksize = val;\n        else if (key == \"ref_price\") meta.ref_price = val;\n        else if (key == \"band\") meta.band = val;\n        else if (key == \"min_volume\") meta.min_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_volume\") meta.max_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"position_limit\") meta.position_limit = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_tps\") meta.max_tps = val;\n        else if (key == \"last_traded_price\") meta.last_traded_price = val;\n    }\n    return meta;\n}\n\n// --- Per-instrument live state, updated by the BBO/MD callbacks ---\nstruct InstrumentState {\n    std::string feed;\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n\n    // Latest BBO snapshot. -1 means \"no quote on that side\" (protocol uses\n    // \"-\" for an empty side).\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\n\n    // Position tracking is a placeholder until order entry exists: this\n    // wildcard MD subscription sees every sender's fills, not just ours, so\n    // there's no \"our position\" to compute yet. Wire this up once we have\n    // our own $SENDER placing orders.\n    long long position = 0;\n};\n\n// All discovered instruments, keyed by feedcode. Callbacks run on nats.c's\n// per-subscription threads, so this map (and the log file) needs a mutex.\nstatic std::map<std::string, InstrumentState> instruments;\nstatic std::mutex instrumentsMutex;\n\n// Shared CSV log file + its own mutex (separate from instrumentsMutex so\n// logging never blocks state updates or vice versa longer than necessary).\nstatic std::ofstream logFile;\nstatic std::mutex logMutex;\n\n// Splits a space-separated ASCII payload into fields.\nstatic std::vector<std::string> splitFields(const char* data, int len) {\n    std::string payload(data, len);\n    std::stringstream ss(payload);\n    std::vector<std::string> fields;\n    std::string word;\n    while (ss >> word) {\n        fields.push_back(word);\n    }\n    return fields;\n}\n\n// Writes one CSV row: \"<source_tag>,<subject>,<field0>,<field1>,...\".\nstatic void writeRow(const char* sourceTag, const char* subject,\n                      const std::vector<std::string>& fields) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\n    logFile << sourceTag << \",\" << subject;\n    for (const auto& f : fields) {\n        logFile << \",\" << f;\n    }\n    logFile << \"\\n\";\n    logFile.flush();\n}\n\n// Extracts the <FEED> token from a subject like \"ex.bbo.AAH6\" or\n// \"ex.md.AAH6.SOMESENDR\". Returns \"\" if the subject doesn't have enough\n// dot-separated parts.\nstatic std::string feedFromSubject(const std::string& subject) {\n    size_t first = subject.find('.');\n    if (first == std::string::npos) return \"\";\n    size_t second = subject.find('.', first + 1);\n    if (second == std::string::npos) return subject.substr(first + 1);\n    return subject.substr(first + 1, second - first - 1);\n}\n\n// Called for every message on ex.bbo.<FEED> for any discovered feed.\n// Payload: \"<ts> <FEED> <bid_px> <bid_vol> <ask_px> <ask_vol>\"\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> fields = splitFields(data, len);\n    writeRow(\"BBO\", subject, fields);\n\n    // fields: [ts, FEED, bid_px, bid_vol, ask_px, ask_vol]\n    if (fields.size() == 6) {\n        std::string feed = fields[1];\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n        auto it = instruments.find(feed);\n        if (it != instruments.end()) {\n            InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n            st.bidPx  = (fields[2] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[2].c_str());\n            st.bidVol = (fields[3] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[3].c_str());\n            st.askPx  = (fields[4] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n            st.askVol = (fields[5] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n        }\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// Called for every message on ex.md.<FEED>.* (all senders) for any\n// discovered feed.\n// Payload: \"<ts> <type> ...\", type in {A, C, E, T} \u2014 see PROTOCOL.md.\n// No state update yet beyond logging \u2014 position tracking needs our own\n// sender's fills, which requires order entry to exist first.\nstatic void onMD(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    writeRow(\"MD\", subject, splitFields(data, len));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    (void)argc; (void)argv;\n\n    logFile.open(\"/data/bbo_data.csv\");\n    if (!logFile.is_open()) {\n        std::cerr << \"Error! File Failed to open\" << std::endl;\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const char* natsUrl = envOr(\"NATS_URL\", \"nats://localhost:4222\");\n    const char* sender  = envOr(\"SENDER\", \"SKEL0001\"); // 8 chars, per PROTOCOL.md\n\n    printf(\"skeleton: connecting to %s as sender=%s\\n\", natsUrl, sender);\n\n    natsStatus s = NATS_OK;\n    natsConnection* conn = nullptr;\n    jsCtx* js = nullptr;\n    kvStore* kv = nullptr;\n\n    // --- 1. Connect ---\n    s = natsConnection_ConnectTo(&conn, natsUrl);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"connect failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return 1;\n    }\n    printf(\"connected.\\n\");\n\n    // --- 2. JetStream context + EX_META KV bind ---\n    if (s == NATS_OK) s = natsConnection_JetStream(&js, conn, nullptr);\n    if (s == NATS_OK) s = js_KeyValue(&kv, js, \"EX_META\");\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"JetStream/KV setup failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    // --- 3. Discover every instrument in EX_META ---\n    kvKeysList keysList;\n    memset(&keysList, 0, sizeof(keysList));\n    s = kvStore_Keys(&keysList, kv, nullptr);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"kvStore_Keys failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return 1;\n    }\n    printf(\"discovered %d instrument(s) in EX_META\\n\", keysList.Count);\n\n    std::vector<natsSubscription*> bboSubs;\n    std::vector<natsSubscription*> mdSubs;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < keysList.Count; ++i) {\n        std::string feed = keysList.Keys[i];\n\n        kvEntry* entry = nullptr;\n        s = kvStore_Get(&entry, kv, feed.c_str());\n        if (s != NATS_OK) {\n            printf(\"kv get failed for %s: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n            s = NATS_OK; // don't let one bad instrument kill startup\n            continue;\n        }\n        std::string metaValue = kvEntry_ValueString(entry);\n        printf(\"[EX_META %s] %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), metaValue.c_str());\n        kvEntry_Destroy(entry);\n\n        InstrumentState st;\n        st.feed = feed;\n        st.meta = parseMeta(metaValue);\n        {\n            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n            instruments[feed] = st;\n        }\n\n        // Subscribe BBO for this feed.\n        char bboSubject[64];\n        snprintf(bboSubject, sizeof(bboSubject), \"ex.bbo.%s\", feed.c_str());\n        natsSubscription* bboSub = nullptr;\n        natsStatus subStatus = natsConnection_Subscribe(&bboSub, conn, bboSubject, onBBO, nullptr);\n        if (subStatus != NATS_OK) {\n            printf(\"BBO subscribe failed for %s: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(subStatus));\n        } else {\n            printf(\"subscribed to %s\\n\", bboSubject);\n            bboSubs.push_back(bboSub);\n        }\n\n        // Subscribe market data (all senders) for this feed.\n        char mdSubject[64];\n        snprintf(mdSubject, sizeof(mdSubject), \"ex.md.%s.*\", feed.c_str());\n        natsSubscription* mdSub = nullptr;\n        subStatus = natsConnection_Subscribe(&mdSub, conn, mdSubject, onMD, nullptr);\n        if (subStatus != NATS_OK) {\n            printf(\"MD subscribe failed for %s: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(subStatus));\n        } else {\n            printf(\"subscribed to %s\\n\", mdSubject);\n            mdSubs.push_back(mdSub);\n        }\n    }\n    kvKeysList_Destroy(&keysList);\n\n    printf(\"logging to /data/bbo_data.csv (Ctrl+C to stop)...\\n\");\n    // Keep the process alive; onBBO/onMD fire asynchronously on nats.c's\n    // internal threads. In the real strategy this loop becomes the event\n    // loop / gets replaced with proper shutdown handling.\n    while (true) {\n        nats_Sleep(1000);\n    }\n\n    // Cleanup (unreached in the loop above, but here for completeness /\n    // once we add signal handling for clean shutdown).\n    for (auto* sub : bboSubs) natsSubscription_Destroy(sub);\n    for (auto* sub : mdSubs) natsSubscription_Destroy(sub);\n    kvStore_Destroy(kv);\n    jsCtx_Destroy(js);\n    natsConnection_Destroy(conn);\n    nats_Close();\n\n    logFile.close();\n\n    return 0;\n}\n"

                            "file_text": "// skeleton.cpp\n//\n// Quoter (strategy/) seat:\n//   1. Connect to NATS at $NATS_URL\n//   2. Discover every instrument in EX_META\n//   3. Per instrument: track a rolling lookback window of mid-prices,\n//      compute realized volatility (rolling stddev) and a z-score of the\n//      current mid vs. the rolling mean\n//   4. Quote fair value = rolling mean, spread sized off realized vol,\n//      skewed by our own inventory and a *bounded* z-score tilt (never a\n//      directional trigger \u2014 see computeQuotes())\n//   5. Track PnL per instrument from our own fills; if PnL since the last\n//      recalibration breaches a loss threshold, recalibrate that\n//      instrument's parameters; otherwise leave them alone\n//   6. Requote on a timer (not per-tick), respecting a min interval as a\n//      crude max_tps throttle\n//\n// Still missing / TODO before this is production-safe:\n//   - Proper max_tps handling (currently a fixed 250ms cycle; should read\n//     EX_META's max_tps per instrument once its semantics for 0 are\n//     confirmed \u2014 see NOTES.md open question)\n//   - Order id uniqueness only holds within ~10k orders per instrument per\n//     process lifetime (4-char feed + 4-digit wrapping sequence)\n//   - No graceful shutdown / order cancellation on exit yet\n//   - Position/PnL uses a simple running-average cost method, not\n//     lot-level accounting \u2014 fine for risk purposes, not for precise P&L\n//\n// Build: see CMakeLists.txt / Dockerfile.\n\n#include <nats.h>\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <deque>\n#include <fstream>\n#include <iostream>\n#include <map>\n#include <mutex>\n#include <set>\n#include <sstream>\n#include <string>\n#include <vector>\n\n// Reads env var with a fallback default, since the grading harness injects\n// real values but local dev needs something sane.\nstatic const char* envOr(const char* name, const char* fallback) {\n    const char* v = std::getenv(name);\n    return (v && v[0] != '\\0') ? v : fallback;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Instrument metadata (parsed from EX_META)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct InstrumentMeta {\n    long long ticksize = 0;\n    long long ref_price = 0;\n    long long band = 0;\n    long long min_volume = 0;\n    long long max_volume = 0;\n    long long position_limit = 0;\n    long long max_tps = 0;\n    long long last_traded_price = 0;\n};\n\nstatic InstrumentMeta parseMeta(const std::string& value) {\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n    std::stringstream ss(value);\n    std::string pair;\n    while (ss >> pair) {\n        auto eq = pair.find('=');\n        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;\n        std::string key = pair.substr(0, eq);\n        long long val = std::atoll(pair.substr(eq + 1).c_str());\n        if (key == \"ticksize\") meta.ticksize = val;\n        else if (key == \"ref_price\") meta.ref_price = val;\n        else if (key == \"band\") meta.band = val;\n        else if (key == \"min_volume\") meta.min_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_volume\") meta.max_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"position_limit\") meta.position_limit = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_tps\") meta.max_tps = val;\n        else if (key == \"last_traded_price\") meta.last_traded_price = val;\n    }\n    return meta;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Per-instrument state\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct InstrumentState {\n    std::string feed;\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n\n    // Latest BBO snapshot. -1 means \"no quote on that side\".\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\n\n    // --- Rolling lookback window for realized vol / z-score ---\n    // Sized in number of mid-price samples, not wall-clock time. Since BBO\n    // update frequency isn't constant, a fixed sample count gives a more\n    // stable window than a fixed time span would.\n    std::deque<double> priceWindow;\n    size_t lookback = 200;\n    double rollingMean = 0.0;\n    double rollingStd = 0.0;\n    double zscore = 0.0;\n\n    // --- Adaptive strategy parameters ---\n    // Set at recalibration time only (startup + loss-triggered), not on\n    // every tick, to avoid chasing noise. spreadMultiplier scales realized\n    // vol into a half-spread; skewPerUnitInventory scales our own position\n    // into a fair-value shift that leans against further accumulation.\n    double spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\n    long long minSpreadTicks = 2;\n    double skewPerUnitInventory = 0.0;\n\n    // --- Position & PnL (from our own fills only) ---\n    long long position = 0;\n    double avgEntryPrice = 0.0;\n    double realizedPnL = 0.0;       // lifetime, informational\n    double pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;   // reset at every recalibration\n    std::set<std::string> seenMatchIds; // avoid double-processing a fill\n\n    // --- Resting order bookkeeping (one bid, one ask per instrument) ---\n    std::string restingBidId, restingAskId;\n    long long restingBidPx = -1, restingAskPx = -1;\n    long long orderSeq = 0;\n\n    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastRequote{};\n};\n\nstatic std::map<std::string, InstrumentState> instruments;\nstatic std::mutex instrumentsMutex;\n\nstatic std::ofstream logFile;\nstatic std::mutex logMutex;\n\nstatic natsConnection* gConn = nullptr;\nstatic std::string gSender;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Small helpers\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic std::vector<std::string> splitFields(const char* data, int len) {\n    std::string payload(data, len);\n    std::stringstream ss(payload);\n    std::vector<std::string> fields;\n    std::string word;\n    while (ss >> word) fields.push_back(word);\n    return fields;\n}\n\nstatic void writeRow(const char* sourceTag, const char* subject,\n                      const std::vector<std::string>& fields) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\n    logFile << sourceTag << \",\" << subject;\n    for (const auto& f : fields) logFile << \",\" << f;\n    logFile << \"\\n\";\n    logFile.flush();\n}\n\n// \"SENDER:ORDERID\" -> SENDER\nstatic std::string senderOf(const std::string& partyTag) {\n    auto colon = partyTag.find(':');\n    return (colon == std::string::npos) ? partyTag : partyTag.substr(0, colon);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Rolling stats\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void updateRollingStats(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 || st.askPx < 0) return; // need both sides for a mid\n    double mid = (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n\n    st.priceWindow.push_back(mid);\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() > st.lookback) st.priceWindow.pop_front();\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() < 2) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sum += p;\n    double mean = sum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size());\n\n    double sqSum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sqSum += (p - mean) * (p - mean);\n    double variance = sqSum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size() - 1);\n    double stddev = std::sqrt(variance);\n\n    st.rollingMean = mean;\n    st.rollingStd = stddev;\n    st.zscore = (stddev > 1e-9) ? (mid - mean) / stddev : 0.0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Recalibration (loss-triggered, not continuous)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void recalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    st.spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\n    st.skewPerUnitInventory = (st.meta.position_limit > 0)\n        ? (st.rollingStd / static_cast<double>(st.meta.position_limit))\n        : 0.0;\n    st.pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;\n    printf(\"[%s] recalibrated: mean=%.2f std=%.4f spreadMult=%.2f skewPerUnit=%.6f\\n\",\n           st.feed.c_str(), st.rollingMean, st.rollingStd, st.spreadMultiplier,\n           st.skewPerUnitInventory);\n}\n\n// Loss threshold, in price units, since the last recalibration. Expressed\n// as a multiple of ticksize so it scales sensibly across instruments with\n// different price levels \u2014 20 ticks is a starting assumption, not a\n// validated number; tune against pilot PnL data.\nstatic double lossThreshold(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    return -20.0 * static_cast<double>(st.meta.ticksize);\n}\n\nstatic void checkAndRecalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.pnlSinceRecalib < lossThreshold(st)) {\n        printf(\"[%s] loss threshold breached (pnlSinceRecalib=%.2f) \u2014 recalibrating\\n\",\n               st.feed.c_str(), st.pnlSinceRecalib);\n        recalibrate(st);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill processing (own fills only)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// side: 'B' or 'S' \u2014 the side WE traded (not the aggressor's side from the\n// wire message; caller resolves that before calling this).\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char side, long long price, long long volume) {\n    double signedVol = (side == 'B') ? static_cast<double>(volume) : -static_cast<double>(volume);\n\n    // Running-average-cost position update. Good enough for risk/PnL\n    // tracking; not lot-level accounting.\n    long long newPosition = st.position + static_cast<long long>(signedVol);\n\n    if (st.position == 0 || (st.position > 0) == (signedVol > 0)) {\n        // Adding to (or opening) a position: extend average entry price.\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))\n                          + static_cast<double>(price) * std::abs(signedVol);\n        double totalVol = std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)) + std::abs(signedVol);\n        st.avgEntryPrice = (totalVol > 0) ? (totalCost / totalVol) : static_cast<double>(price);\n    } else {\n        // Reducing or flipping a position: realize PnL on the closed part.\n        double closedVol = std::min(std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)), std::abs(signedVol));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0)\n            ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n            : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        double pnl = pnlPerUnit * closedVol;\n        st.realizedPnL += pnl;\n        st.pnlSinceRecalib += pnl;\n\n        if (std::abs(signedVol) > std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))) {\n            // Flipped through flat \u2014 new position takes on the fill price.\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n\n    st.position = newPosition;\n    checkAndRecalibrate(st);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Quote computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct Quote {\n    bool valid = false;\n    long long bidPx = -1, askPx = -1, vol = -1;\n};\n\nstatic Quote computeQuotes(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    Quote q;\n    // Not enough data to have a meaningful fair value yet \u2014 stay out.\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() < st.lookback / 4) return q;\n    if (st.meta.ticksize <= 0) return q;\n\n    double fairValue = st.rollingMean;\n\n    double halfSpread = std::max(\n        st.spreadMultiplier * st.rollingStd / 2.0,\n        static_cast<double>(st.minSpreadTicks * st.meta.ticksize) / 2.0);\n\n    // Inventory skew: lean the fair value away from our current position so\n    // resting quotes naturally bias toward flattening.\n    double inventorySkew = -st.skewPerUnitInventory * static_cast<double>(st.position);\n\n    // Z-score tilt: bounded to a quarter of the half-spread and clamped to\n    // +/-2 std, so it nudges quoting rather than becoming a directional\n    // signal. This is a mean-reversion bias on a market-making quote, not\n    // a \"take a position because z-score says so\" trigger.\n    double clampedZ = std::clamp(st.zscore, -2.0, 2.0);\n    double zscoreTilt = -clampedZ * (halfSpread * 0.25);\n\n    double adjustedFV = fairValue + inventorySkew + zscoreTilt;\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV - halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV + halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    long long lo = st.meta.ref_price - st.meta.band;\n    long long hi = st.meta.ref_price + st.meta.band;\n    bidPx = std::clamp(bidPx, lo, hi);\n    askPx = std::clamp(askPx, lo, hi);\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    // Base size: placeholder fixed size within instrument limits. Sizing\n    // strategy (e.g. scaling down as position approaches position_limit)\n    // is a further refinement, not yet implemented.\n    long long baseSize = 10;\n    long long vol = std::max(st.meta.min_volume, std::min(st.meta.max_volume, baseSize));\n\n    q.valid = true;\n    q.bidPx = bidPx;\n    q.askPx = askPx;\n    q.vol = vol;\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry (ex.req.<SENDER> request/reply)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    // 4-char feed (feeds are always 4 chars per PROTOCOL.md) + 4-digit\n    // wrapping sequence = 8 chars, unique per feed for ~10k live orders.\n    char buf[9];\n    long long seq = (st.orderSeq++) % 10000;\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), seq);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> A <FEED> <id> <B|S> <volume> <price> <L>\" and returns\n// true if the exchange accepted it (reply starts with \"Y\").\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId,\n                      char side, long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\",\n              gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\".\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s C %s %s\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\n\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs meaningfully\n// from what's currently resting. Called on a timer, not per-tick.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st) {\n    Quote q = computeQuotes(st);\n    if (!q.valid) return;\n\n    bool bidNeedsUpdate = (st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx);\n    bool askNeedsUpdate = (st.restingAskPx != q.askPx);\n\n    if (bidNeedsUpdate) {\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, st.restingBidId);\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'B', q.vol, q.bidPx)) {\n            st.restingBidId = id;\n            st.restingBidPx = q.bidPx;\n        } else {\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n        }\n    }\n    if (askNeedsUpdate) {\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, st.restingAskId);\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'S', q.vol, q.askPx)) {\n            st.restingAskId = id;\n            st.restingAskPx = q.askPx;\n        } else {\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// NATS callbacks\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> fields = splitFields(data, len);\n    writeRow(\"BBO\", subject, fields);\n\n    // fields: [ts, FEED, bid_px, bid_vol, ask_px, ask_vol]\n    if (fields.size() == 6) {\n        std::string feed = fields[1];\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n        auto it = instruments.find(feed);\n        if (it != instruments.end()) {\n            InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n            st.bidPx  = (fields[2] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[2].c_str());\n            st.bidVol = (fields[3] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[3].c_str());\n            st.askPx  = (fields[4] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n            st.askVol = (fields[5] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n            updateRollingStats(st);\n        }\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// Payload: \"<ts> <type> ...\", type in {A, C, E, T}.\n//   E/T: <incoming:17> <resting:17> <volume> <price> <matchid> <B|S>\n// We only care about E/T rows where WE are one of the two parties.\nstatic void onMD(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> fields = splitFields(data, len);\n    writeRow(\"MD\", subject, fields);\n\n    if (fields.size() < 2) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    const std::string& type = fields[1];\n    if (type != \"E\" && type != \"T\") { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    // E/T fields (after ts, type): incoming, resting, volume, price, matchid, aggressorSide\n    if (fields.size() != 8) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n\n    std::string incoming = fields[2];\n    std::string resting  = fields[3];\n    long long volume     = std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n    long long price       = std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n    std::string matchId  = fields[6];\n    char aggressorSide    = fields[7].empty() ? '?' : fields[7][0];\n\n    bool weAreIncoming = senderOf(incoming) == gSender;\n    bool weAreResting  = senderOf(resting) == gSender;\n    if (!weAreIncoming && !weAreResting) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n\n    // Subject is ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>\n    std::string subj(subject);\n    size_t firstDot = subj.find('.');\n    size_t secondDot = (firstDot == std::string::npos) ? std::string::npos : subj.find('.', firstDot + 1);\n    size_t thirdDot = (secondDot == std::string::npos) ? std::string::npos : subj.find('.', secondDot + 1);\n    if (secondDot == std::string::npos || thirdDot == std::string::npos) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    std::string feed = subj.substr(secondDot + 1, thirdDot - secondDot - 1);\n\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n    auto it = instruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == instruments.end()) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    // Dedupe: E and T are two addressings of the same trade. Fixed cadence is a crude stand-in for real max_tps\n    // throttling \u2014 see the TODO at the top of this file.\n    const auto requoteInterval = std::chrono::milliseconds(250);\n    while (true) {\n        std::this_thread::sleep_for(requoteInterval);\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n        for (auto& [feed, st] : instruments) {\n            requoteInstrument(st);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Unreached (no shutdown handling yet).\n    for (auto* sub : bboSubs) natsSubscription_Destroy(sub);\n    for (auto* sub : mdSubs) natsSubscription_Destroy(sub);\n    kvStore_Destroy(kv);\n    jsCtx_Destroy(js);\n    natsConnection_Destroy(gConn);\n    nats_Close();\n    logFile.close();\n    return 0;\n}\n"

                "text": "Worth pushing back on that assumption before you go build the hedger \u2014 the hedger's job is to flatten the **combined desk position**, not to fix the quoter's own PnL. A missing hedger means your position can grow larger and sit exposed longer, which is a **risk** problem (exactly what TASK.md warns about), but it doesn't by itself cause negative *realized* PnL from the quoting activity. If your quoting logic has positive edge, you'd expect positive realized PnL even with unbounded inventory, just riskier. So if PnL is actually negative, something in the quoting itself is probably losing money on its own terms, and building the hedger won't fix that \u2014 it'll just cap how bad the exposure gets while it's happening.\n\nMore likely candidates, given what you've built:\n\n1. **Rolling-mean fair value lags a trending market.** You confirmed the mover genuinely walks the price (not mean-reverting), and your fair value is a rolling *mean* over a lookback window \u2014 that's structurally always behind during a sustained walk. If price is drifting up, your mean-based fair value sits below the real market, your ask ends up too cheap, and informed flow (or the mover itself) buys from you systematically below where price is heading. That's classic adverse selection, and it's a strong candidate for exactly what you're seeing.\n2. **250ms requote cadence is slow relative to the mover's sweeps.** If price gaps meaningfully within that window, your stale resting quotes are sitting targets until the next cycle catches up.\n3. **Spread too tight to cover round-trip cost.** Worth checking whether `spreadMultiplier = 2.0` (your default) is actually wide enough on average to overcome adverse selection, or if it's calibrated more for \"quote often\" than \"quote profitably.\"\n\nYou've already got the diagnostic tools for this \u2014 `realizedPnL` and `pnlSinceRecalib` are tracked per instrument. Concretely, I'd check:\n- Does PnL loss cluster in time around the spread-spike/sweep events you found earlier, or is it spread evenly? That tells you if it's an adverse-selection-during-sweeps problem specifically, or a systemic edge problem.\n- What's your fill count and win/loss split by side (buys vs sells)?                         "extracted_content": "// skeleton.cpp\n//\n// Quoter (strategy/) seat:\n//   1. Connect to NATS at $NATS_URL\n//   2. Discover every instrument in EX_META\n//   3. Per instrument: track a rolling lookback window of mid-prices,\n//      compute realized volatility (rolling stddev) and a z-score of the\n//      current mid vs. the rolling mean\n//   4. Quote fair value = rolling mean, spread sized off realized vol,\n//      skewed by our own inventory and a *bounded* z-score tilt (never a\n//      directional trigger \u2014 see computeQuotes())\n//   5. Track PnL per instrument from our own fills; if PnL since the last\n//      recalibration breaches a loss threshold, recalibrate that\n//      instrument's parameters; otherwise leave them alone\n//   6. Requote on a timer (not per-tick), respecting a min interval as a\n//      crude max_tps throttle\n//\n// Still missing / TODO before this is production-safe:\n//   - Proper max_tps handling (currently a fixed 250ms cycle; should read\n//     EX_META's max_tps per instrument once its semantics for 0 are\n//     confirmed \u2014 see NOTES.md open question)\n//   - Order id uniqueness only holds within ~10k orders per instrument per\n//     process lifetime (4-char feed + 4-digit wrapping sequence)\n//   - No graceful shutdown / order cancellation on exit yet\n//   - Position/PnL uses a simple running-average cost method, not\n//     lot-level accounting \u2014 fine for risk purposes, not for precise P&L\n//\n// Build: see CMakeLists.txt / Dockerfile.\n\n#include <nats.h>\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <deque>\n#include <fstream>\n#include <iostream>\n#include <map>\n#include <mutex>\n#include <set>\n#include <sstream>\n#include <string>\n#include <thread>\n#include <vector>\n\n// Reads env var with a fallback default, since the grading harness injects\n// real values but local dev needs something sane.\nstatic const char* envOr(const char* name, const char* fallback) {\n    const char* v = std::getenv(name);\n    return (v && v[0] != '\\0') ? v : fallback;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Instrument metadata (parsed from EX_META)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct InstrumentMeta {\n    long long ticksize = 0;\n    long long ref_price = 0;\n    long long band = 0;\n    long long min_volume = 0;\n    long long max_volume = 0;\n    long long position_limit = 0;\n    long long max_tps = 0;\n    long long last_traded_price = 0;\n};\n\nstatic InstrumentMeta parseMeta(const std::string& value) {\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n    std::stringstream ss(value);\n    std::string pair;\n    while (ss >> pair) {\n        auto eq = pair.find('=');\n        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;\n        std::string key = pair.substr(0, eq);\n        long long val = std::atoll(pair.substr(eq + 1).c_str());\n        if (key == \"ticksize\") meta.ticksize = val;\n        else if (key == \"ref_price\") meta.ref_price = val;\n        else if (key == \"band\") meta.band = val;\n        else if (key == \"min_volume\") meta.min_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_volume\") meta.max_volume = val;\n        else if (key == \"position_limit\") meta.position_limit = val;\n        else if (key == \"max_tps\") meta.max_tps = val;\n        else if (key == \"last_traded_price\") meta.last_traded_price = val;\n    }\n    return meta;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Per-instrument state\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct InstrumentState {\n    std::string feed;\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\n\n    // Latest BBO snapshot. -1 means \"no quote on that side\".\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\n\n    // --- Rolling lookback window for realized vol / z-score ---\n    // Sized in number of mid-price samples, not wall-clock time. Since BBO\n    // update frequency isn't constant, a fixed sample count gives a more\n    // stable window than a fixed time span would.\n    std::deque<double> priceWindow;\n    size_t lookback = 200;\n    double rollingMean = 0.0;\n    double rollingStd = 0.0;\n    double zscore = 0.0;\n\n    // --- Adaptive strategy parameters ---\n    // Set at recalibration time only (startup + loss-triggered), not on\n    // every tick, to avoid chasing noise. spreadMultiplier scales realized\n    // vol into a half-spread; skewPerUnitInventory scales our own position\n    // into a fair-value shift that leans against further accumulation.\n    double spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\n    long long minSpreadTicks = 2;\n    double skewPerUnitInventory = 0.0;\n\n    // --- Position & PnL (from our own fills only) ---\n    long long position = 0;\n    double avgEntryPrice = 0.0;\n    double realizedPnL = 0.0;       // lifetime, informational\n    double pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;   // reset at every recalibration\n    std::set<std::string> seenMatchIds; // avoid double-processing a fill\n\n    // --- Resting order bookkeeping (one bid, one ask per instrument) ---\n    std::string restingBidId, restingAskId;\n    long long restingBidPx = -1, restingAskPx = -1;\n    long long orderSeq = 0;\n\n    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastRequote{};\n};\n\nstatic std::map<std::string, InstrumentState> instruments;\nstatic std::mutex instrumentsMutex;\n\nstatic std::ofstream logFile;\nstatic std::mutex logMutex;\n\n// Dedicated PnL/loss log, separate from the raw market-data dump above so\n// you can actually eyeball or plot PnL without filtering out BBO/MD noise.\nstatic std::ofstream pnlFile;\nstatic std::mutex pnlMutex;\n\nstatic natsConnection* gConn = nullptr;\nstatic std::string gSender;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Small helpers\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic std::vector<std::string> splitFields(const char* data, int len) {\n    std::string payload(data, len);\n    std::stringstream ss(payload);\n    std::vector<std::string> fields;\n    std::string word;\n    while (ss >> word) fields.push_back(word);\n    return fields;\n}\n\nstatic void writeRow(const char* sourceTag, const char* subject,\n                      const std::vector<std::string>& fields) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\n    logFile << sourceTag << \",\" << subject;\n    for (const auto& f : fields) logFile << \",\" << f;\n    logFile << \"\\n\";\n    logFile.flush();\n}\n\n// \"SENDER:ORDERID\" -> SENDER\nstatic std::string senderOf(const std::string& partyTag) {\n    auto colon = partyTag.find(':');\n    return (colon == std::string::npos) ? partyTag : partyTag.substr(0, colon);\n}\n\n// std::clamp requires C++17; using a local helper instead of bumping the\n// project's C++ standard, since that's unconfirmed elsewhere in the build.\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T clampValue(T v, T lo, T hi) {\n    return (v < lo) ? lo : (v > hi) ? hi : v;\n}\n\nstatic long long nowNanos() {\n    auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch();\n    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(now).count();\n}\n\n// Current mid from the latest BBO, if both sides are present; falls back to\n// rollingMean (last known mid) if one side is currently empty, so PnL marks\n// don't go stale/undefined just because the book is one-sided for a tick.\nstatic double currentMid(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx >= 0 && st.askPx >= 0) {\n        return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n    }\n    return st.rollingMean;\n}\n\n// Unrealized PnL: mark our open position at the current mid vs. our average\n// entry price. This is what makes a losing OPEN position visible \u2014 realizedPnL\n// alone stays at 0 until you actually reduce/close, so a position bleeding\n// against you looks invisible without this.\nstatic double unrealizedPnL(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.position == 0) return 0.0;\n    double mid = currentMid(st);\n    double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0) ? (mid - st.avgEntryPrice) : (st.avgEntryPrice - mid);\n    return pnlPerUnit * std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position));\n}\n\n// Writes one row to the dedicated PnL/loss csv (data/pnl.csv), writing the\n// header once on first use. event_type is \"FILL\" (one row per fill) or\n// \"SNAPSHOT\" (one row per periodic tick, so you can see PnL drift even with\n// no fills, e.g. an open position bleeding against you).\nstatic bool pnlHeaderWritten = false;\nstatic void writePnlRow(const char* eventType, const InstrumentState& st,\n                         double pnlDelta, const char* side, long long price,\n                         long long volume) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(pnlMutex);\n    if (!pnlHeaderWritten) {\n        pnlFile << \"ts,event_type,feed,side,fill_price,fill_volume,position,\"\n                    \"avg_entry_price,mid,realized_pnl,unrealized_pnl,total_pnl,\"\n                    \"pnl_since_recalib\\n\";\n        pnlHeaderWritten = true;\n    }\n    double unreal = unrealizedPnL(st);\n    pnlFile << nowNanos() << \",\" << eventType << \",\" << st.feed << \",\"\n             << side << \",\" << price << \",\" << volume << \",\" << st.position << \",\"\n             << st.avgEntryPrice << \",\" << currentMid(st) << \",\" << st.realizedPnL << \",\"\n             << unreal << \",\" << (st.realizedPnL + unreal) << \",\" << st.pnlSinceRecalib\n             << \"\\n\";\n    pnlFile.flush();\n    (void)pnlDelta; // kept as a param for FILL rows if you want to log it separately later\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Rolling stats\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void updateRollingStats(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 || st.askPx < 0) return; // need both sides for a mid\n    double mid = (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n\n    st.priceWindow.push_back(mid);\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() > st.lookback) st.priceWindow.pop_front();\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() < 2) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sum += p;\n    double mean = sum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size());\n\n    double sqSum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sqSum += (p - mean) * (p - mean);\n    double variance = sqSum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size() - 1);\n    double stddev = std::sqrt(variance);\n\n    st.rollingMean = mean;\n    st.rollingStd = stddev;\n    st.zscore = (stddev > 1e-9) ? (mid - mean) / stddev : 0.0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Recalibration (loss-triggered, not continuous)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void recalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    st.spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\n    st.skewPerUnitInventory = (st.meta.position_limit > 0)\n        ? (st.rollingStd / static_cast<double>(st.meta.position_limit))\n        : 0.0;\n    st.pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;\n    printf(\"[%s] recalibrated: mean=%.2f std=%.4f spreadMult=%.2f skewPerUnit=%.6f\\n\",\n           st.feed.c_str(), st.rollingMean, st.rollingStd, st.spreadMultiplier,\n           st.skewPerUnitInventory);\n}\n\n// Loss threshold, in price units, since the last recalibration. Expressed\n// as a multiple of ticksize so it scales sensibly across instruments with\n// different price levels \u2014 20 ticks is a starting assumption, not a\n// validated number; tune against pilot PnL data.\nstatic double lossThreshold(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    return -20.0 * static_cast<double>(st.meta.ticksize);\n}\n\nstatic void checkAndRecalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.pnlSinceRecalib < lossThreshold(st)) {\n        printf(\"[%s] loss threshold breached (pnlSinceRecalib=%.2f) \u2014 recalibrating\\n\",\n               st.feed.c_str(), st.pnlSinceRecalib);\n        recalibrate(st);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill processing (own fills only)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// side: 'B' or 'S' \u2014 the side WE traded (not the aggressor's side from the\n// wire message; caller resolves that before calling this).\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char side, long long price, long long volume) {\n    double signedVol = (side == 'B') ? static_cast<double>(volume) : -static_cast<double>(volume);\n    long long positionBefore = st.position;\n    long long newPosition = st.position + static_cast<long long>(signedVol);\n    double pnlDelta = 0.0;\n\n    if (st.position == 0 || (st.position > 0) == (signedVol > 0)) {\n        // Adding to (or opening) a position: extend average entry price.\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))\n                          + static_cast<double>(price) * std::abs(signedVol);\n        double totalVol = std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)) + std::abs(signedVol);\n        st.avgEntryPrice = (totalVol > 0) ? (totalCost / totalVol) : static_cast<double>(price);\n    } else {\n        // Reducing or flipping a position: realize PnL on the closed part.\n        double closedVol = std::min(std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)), std::abs(signedVol));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0)\n            ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n            : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        pnlDelta = pnlPerUnit * closedVol;\n        st.realizedPnL += pnlDelta;\n        st.pnlSinceRecalib += pnlDelta;\n\n        if (std::abs(signedVol) > std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))) {\n            // Flipped through flat \u2014 new position takes on the fill price.\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n\n    st.position = newPosition;\n\n    // FILL row: ts, feed, side, price, volume, positionBefore, positionAfter,\n    // pnlDelta (this fill only), realizedPnL (lifetime), pnlSinceRecalib.\n    {\n        std::stringstream ss;\n        ss << nowNanos() << \",\" << st.feed << \",\" << side << \",\" << price << \",\"\n           << volume << \",\" << positionBefore << \",\" << newPosition << \",\"\n           << pnlDelta << \",\" << st.realizedPnL << \",\" << st.pnlSinceRecalib;\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\n        logFile << \"FILL,\" << ss.str() << \"\\n\";\n        logFile.flush();\n    }\n\n    // Dedicated PnL log row for this fill \u2014 this is the one to watch for\n    // losses, since it carries realized + unrealized + total in one place.\n    writePnlRow(\"FILL\", st, pnlDelta, std::string(1, side).c_str(), price, volume);\n\n    checkAndRecalibrate(st);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Quote computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct Quote {\n    bool valid = false;\n    long long bidPx = -1, askPx = -1, vol = -1;\n};\n\nstatic Quote computeQuotes(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    Quote q;\n    // Not enough data to have a meaningful fair value yet \u2014 stay out.\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() < st.lookback / 4) return q;\n    if (st.meta.ticksize <= 0) return q;\n\n    double fairValue = st.rollingMean;\n\n    double halfSpread = std::max(\n        st.spreadMultiplier * st.rollingStd / 2.0,\n        static_cast<double>(st.minSpreadTicks * st.meta.ticksize) / 2.0);\n\n    // Inventory skew: lean the fair value away from our current position so\n    // resting quotes naturally bias toward flattening.\n    double inventorySkew = -st.skewPerUnitInventory * static_cast<double>(st.position);\n\n    // Z-score tilt: bounded to a quarter of the half-spread and clamped to\n    // +/-2 std, so it nudges quoting rather than becoming a directional\n    // signal. This is a mean-reversion bias on a market-making quote, not\n    // a \"take a position because z-score says so\" trigger.\n    double clampedZ = clampValue(st.zscore, -2.0, 2.0);\n    double zscoreTilt = -clampedZ * (halfSpread * 0.25);\n\n    double adjustedFV = fairValue + inventorySkew + zscoreTilt;\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV - halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV + halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    long long lo = st.meta.ref_price - st.meta.band;\n    long long hi = st.meta.ref_price + st.meta.band;\n    bidPx = clampValue(bidPx, lo, hi);\n    askPx = clampValue(askPx, lo, hi);\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    // Base size: placeholder fixed size within instrument limits. Sizing\n    // strategy (e.g. scaling down as position approaches position_limit)\n    // is a further refinement, not yet implemented.\n    long long baseSize = 10;\n    long long vol = std::max(st.meta.min_volume, std::min(st.meta.max_volume, baseSize));\n\n    q.valid = true;\n    q.bidPx = bidPx;\n    q.askPx = askPx;\n    q.vol = vol;\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry (ex.req.<SENDER> request/reply)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    // 4-char feed (feeds are always 4 chars per PROTOCOL.md) + 4-digit\n    // wrapping sequence = 8 chars, unique per feed for ~10k live orders.\n    char buf[9];\n    long long seq = (st.orderSeq++) % 10000;\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), seq);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> A <FEED> <id> <B|S> <volume> <price> <L>\" and returns\n// true if the exchange accepted it (reply starts with \"Y\").\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId,\n                      char side, long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\",\n              gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\".\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s C %s %s\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\n\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs meaningfully\n// from what's currently resting. Called on a timer, not per-tick.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st) {\n    Quote q = computeQuotes(st);\n    if (!q.valid) return;\n\n    bool bidNeedsUpdate = (st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx);\n    bool askNeedsUpdate = (st.restingAskPx != q.askPx);\n\n    if (bidNeedsUpdate) {\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, st.restingBidId);\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'B', q.vol, q.bidPx)) {\n            st.restingBidId = id;\n            st.restingBidPx = q.bidPx;\n        } else {\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n        }\n    }\n    if (askNeedsUpdate) {\n        cancelOrder(st.feed, st.restingAskId);\n        std::string id = nextOrderId(st);\n        if (addOrder(st.feed, id, 'S', q.vol, q.askPx)) {\n            st.restingAskId = id;\n            st.restingAskPx = q.askPx;\n        } else {\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// NATS callbacks\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> fields = splitFields(data, len);\n    writeRow(\"BBO\", subject, fields);\n\n    // fields: [ts, FEED, bid_px, bid_vol, ask_px, ask_vol]\n    if (fields.size() == 6) {\n        std::string feed = fields[1];\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n        auto it = instruments.find(feed);\n        if (it != instruments.end()) {\n            InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n            st.bidPx  = (fields[2] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[2].c_str());\n            st.bidVol = (fields[3] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[3].c_str());\n            st.askPx  = (fields[4] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n            st.askVol = (fields[5] == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n            updateRollingStats(st);\n        }\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// Payload: \"<ts> <type> ...\", type in {A, C, E, T}.\n//   E/T: <incoming:17> <resting:17> <volume> <price> <matchid> <B|S>\n// We only care about E/T rows where WE are one of the two parties.\nstatic void onMD(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc; (void)sub; (void)closure;\n\n    const char* data = natsMsg_GetData(msg);\n    int len = natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg);\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> fields = splitFields(data, len);\n    writeRow(\"MD\", subject, fields);\n\n    if (fields.size() < 2) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    const std::string& type = fields[1];\n    if (type != \"E\" && type != \"T\") { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    // E/T fields (after ts, type): incoming, resting, volume, price, matchid, aggressorSide\n    if (fields.size() != 8) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n\n    std::string incoming = fields[2];\n    std::string resting  = fields[3];\n    long long volume     = std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n    long long price       = std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n    std::string matchId  = fields[6];\n    char aggressorSide    = fields[7].empty() ? '?' : fields[7][0];\n\n    bool weAreIncoming = senderOf(incoming) == gSender;\n    bool weAreResting  = senderOf(resting) == gSender;\n    if (!weAreIncoming && !weAreResting) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n\n    // Subject is ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>\n    std::string subj(subject);\n    size_t firstDot = subj.find('.');\n    size_t secondDot = (firstDot == std::string::npos) ? std::string::npos : subj.find('.', firstDot + 1);\n    size_t thirdDot = (secondDot == std::string::npos) ? std::string::npos : subj.find('.', secondDot + 1);\n    if (secondDot == std::string::npos || thirdDot == std::string::npos) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    std::string feed = subj.substr(secondDot + 1, thirdDot - secondDot - 1);\n\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(instrumentsMutex);\n    auto it = instruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == instruments.end()) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    // Dedupe: E and T are two addressings of the same trade. If we're both\n    // parties (self-cross) we'd see both \u2014 process a given matchid once.\n    if (st.seenMatchIds.count(matchId)) { natsMsg_Destroy(msg); return; }\n    st.seenMatchIds.insert(matchId);\n    if (st.seenMatchIds.size() > 100000) st.seenMatchIds.clear(); // crude cap\n\n    // Our side of the trade: if we're the incoming/aggressor, we traded the\n    // aggressor's side; if we're resting, we traded the opposite side.\n    char ourSide = weAreIncoming ? aggressorSide\n                                  : (aggressorSide == 'B' ? 'S' : 'B');\n\n    applyFill(st, ourSide, price, volume);\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// main\n// ============================================================================\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    (void)argc; (void)argv;\n\n    logFile.open(\"/data/bbo_data.csv\");\n    if (!logFile.is_open()) {\n        std::cerr << \"Error! This is what makes a losing OPEN position visible \u2014 realizedPnL\n// alone stays at 0 until you actually reduce/close, so a position bleeding\n// against you looks invisible without this.\nstatic double unrealizedPnL(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.position == 0) return 0.0;\n    double mid = currentMid(st);\n    double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0) ? (mid - st.avgEntryPrice) : (st.avgEntryPrice - mid);\n    return pnlPerUnit * std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position));\n}\n\n// Writes one row to the dedicated PnL/loss csv (data/pnl.csv), writing the\n// header once on first use. event_type is \"FILL\" (one row per fill) or\n// \"SNAPSHOT\" (one row per periodic tick, so you can see PnL drift even with\n// no fills, e.g. an open position bleeding against you).\nstatic bool pnlHeaderWritten = false;\nstatic void writePnlRow(const char* eventType, const InstrumentState& st,\n                         double pnlDelta, const char* side, long long price,\n                         long long volume) {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(pnlMutex);\n    if (!pnlHeaderWritten) {\n        pnlFile << \"ts,event_type,feed,side,fill_price,fill_volume,position,\"\n                    \"avg_entry_price,mid,realized_pnl,unrealized_pnl,total_pnl,\"\n                    \"pnl_since_recalib\\n\";\n        pnlHeaderWritten = true;\n    }\n    double unreal = unrealizedPnL(st);\n    pnlFile << nowNanos() << \",\" << eventType << \",\" << st.feed << \",\"\n             << side << \",\" << price << \",\" << volume << \",\" << st.position << \",\"\n             << st.avgEntryPrice << \",\" << currentMid(st) << \",\" << st.realizedPnL << \",\"\n             << unreal << \",\" << (st.realizedPnL + unreal) << \",\" << st.pnlSinceRecalib\n             << \"\\n\";\n    pnlFile.flush();\n    (void)pnlDelta; // kept as a param for FILL rows if you want to log it separately later\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Rolling stats\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void updateRollingStats(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 || st.askPx < 0) return; // need both sides for a mid\n    double mid = (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n\n    st.priceWindow.push_back(mid);\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() > st.lookback) st.priceWindow.pop_front();\n    if (st.priceWindow.size() < 2) return;\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sum += p;\n    double mean = sum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size());\n\n    double sqSum = 0.0;\n    for (double p : st.priceWindow) sqSum += (p - mean) * (p - mean);\n    double variance = sqSum / static_cast<double>(st.priceWindow.size() - 1);\n    double stddev = std::sqrt(variance);\n\n    st.rollingMean = mean;\n    st.rollingStd = stddev;\n    st.zscore = (stddev > 1e-9) ? (mid - mean) / stddev : 0.0;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Recalibration (loss-triggered, not continuous)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void recalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    st.spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\n    st.skewPerUnitInventory = (st.meta.position_limit > 0)\n        ? (st.rollingStd / static_cast<double>(st.meta.position_limit))\n        : 0.0;\n    st.pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;\n    printf(\"[%s] recalibrated: mean=%.2f std=%.4f spreadMult=%.2f skewPerUnit=%.6f\\n\",\n           st.feed.c_str(), st.rollingMean, st.rollingStd, st.spreadMultiplier,\n           st.skewPerUnitInventory);\n}\n\n// Loss threshold, in price units, since the last recalibration. Expressed\n// as a multiple of ticksize so it scales sensibly across instruments with\n// different price levels \u2014 20 ticks is a starting assumption, not a\n// validated number; tune against pilot PnL data.\nstatic double lossThreshold(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    return -20.0 * static_cast<double>(st.meta.ticksize);\n}\n\nstatic void checkAndRecalibrate(InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.pnlSinceRecalib < lossThreshold(st)) {\n        printf(\"[%s] loss threshold breached (pnlSinceRecalib=%.2f) \u2014 recalibrating\\n\",\n               st.feed.c_str(), st.pnlSinceRecalib);\n        recalibrate(st);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill processing (own fills only)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// side: 'B' or 'S' \u2014 the side WE traded (not the aggressor's side from the\n// wire message; caller resolves that before calling this).\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char side, long long price, long long volume) {\n    double signedVol = (side == 'B') ? static_cast<double>(volume) : -static_cast<double>(volume);\n    long long positionBefore = st.position;\n    long long newPosition = st.position + static_cast<long long>(signedVol);\n    double pnlDelta = 0.0;\n\n    if (st.position == 0 || (st.position > 0) == (signedVol > 0)) {\n        // Adding to (or opening) a position: extend average entry price.\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))\n                          + static_cast<double>(price) * std::abs(signedVol);\n        double totalVol = std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)) + std::abs(signedVol);\n        st.avgEntryPrice = (totalVol > 0) ? (totalCost / totalVol) : static_cast<double>(price);\n    } else {\n        // Reducing or flipping a position: realize PnL on the closed part.\n        double closedVol = std::min(std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position)), std::abs(signedVol));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0)\n            ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n            : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        pnlDelta = pnlPerUnit * closedVol;\n        st.realizedPnL += pnlDelta;\n        st.pnlSinceRecalib += pnlDelta;\n\n        if (std::abs(signedVol) > std::abs(static_cast<double>(st.position))) {\n            // Flipped through flat \u2014 new position takes on the fill price.\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n\n    st.position = newPosition;\n\n    // FILL row: ts, feed, side, price, volume, positionBefore, positionAfter,\n    // pnlDelta (this fill only), realizedPnL (lifetime), pnlSinceRecalib.\n    {\n        std::stringstream ss;\n        ss << nowNanos() << \",\" << st.feed << \",\" << side << \",\" << price << \",\"\n           << volume << \",\" << positionBefore << \",\" << newPosition << \",\"\n           << pnlDelta << \",\" << st.realizedPnL << \",\" << st.pnlSinceRecalib;\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\n        logFile << \"FILL,\" << ss.str() << \"\\n\";\n        logFile.flush();\n    }\n\n    // Dedicated PnL log row for this fill \u2014 this is the one to watch for\n    // losses, since it carries realized + unrealized + total in one place.\n    writePnlRow(\"FILL\", st, pnlDelta, std::string(1, side).c_str(), price, volume);\n\n    checkAndRecalibrate(st);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Quote computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct Quote {\n    bool valid = false;\n    long long bidPx = -1, askPx = -1, vol = -1;\n};\n\nstatic Quote computeQuotes(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    Quote q;\n    if (st.meta.ticksize <= 0) return q;\n    // No usable price at all \u2014 no rolling data AND no ref_price from\n    // EX_META (would be 0 if the key were missing/malformed). Stay out.\n    if (st.priceWindow.empty() && st.meta.ref_price <= 0) return q;\n\n    double fv = fairValue(st);\n\n    // rollingStd is 0 until the window has >= 2 samples, so before that,\n    // half-spread is entirely the tick-based floor below \u2014 this is the\n    // cold-start case where we're quoting off ref_price, not realized vol.\n    double halfSpread = std::max(\n        st.spreadMultiplier * st.rollingStd / 2.0,\n        static_cast<double>(st.minSpreadTicks * st.meta.ticksize) / 2.0);\n\n    // Inventory skew: lean the fair value away from our current position so\n    // resting quotes naturally bias toward flattening.\n    double inventorySkew = -st.skewPerUnitInventory * static_cast<double>(st.position);\n\n    // Z-score tilt: bounded to a quarter of the half-spread and clamped to\n    // +/-2 std, so it nudges quoting rather than becoming a directional\n    // signal. This is a mean-reversion bias on a market-making quote, not\n    // a \"take a position because z-score says so\" trigger.\n    double clampedZ = clampValue(st.zscore, -2.0, 2.0);\n    double zscoreTilt = -clampedZ * (halfSpread * 0.25);\n\n    double adjustedFV = fv + inventorySkew + zscoreTilt;\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV - halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::round((adjustedFV + halfSpread) / st.meta.ticksize))\n                       * st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    long long lo = st.meta.ref_price - st.meta.band;\n    long long hi = st.meta.ref_price + st.meta.band;\n    bidPx = clampValue(bidPx, lo, hi);\n    askPx = clampValue(askPx, lo, hi);\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + st.meta.ticksize;\n\n    // Base size: placeholder fixed size within instrument limits. Sizing\n    // strategy (e.g. scaling down as position approaches position_limit)\n    // is a further refinement, not yet implemented.\n    long long baseSize = 10;\n    long long vol = std::max(st.meta.min_volume, std::min(st.meta.max_volume, baseSize));\n\n    q.valid = true;\n    q.bidPx = bidPx;\n    q.askPx = askPx;\n    q.vol = vol;\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    // 4-char feed (feeds are always 4 chars per PROTOCOL.md) + Sends \"<SENDER> C <FEED> <id>\".\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, Position/PnL uses a simple running-average cost method, not\\n//     lot-level accounting \\u2014 fine for risk purposes, not for precise P&L\\n//\\n// Build: see CMakeLists.txt / Dockerfile.\\n\\n#include <nats.h>\\n#include <algorithm>\\n#include <chrono>\\n#include <cmath>\\n#include <cstdio>\\n#include <cstdlib>\\n#include <cstring>\\n#include <deque>\\n#include std::getenv(name);\\n    return (v && v[0] != '\\\\0') ? v : fallback;\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Instrument metadata (parsed from EX_META)\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstruct InstrumentMeta {\\n    long long ticksize = 0;\\n    long long ref_price = 0;\\n    long long InstrumentMeta parseMeta(const std::string& value) {\\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\\n    std::stringstream ss(value);\\n    std::string pair;\\n    while (ss >> pair) {\\n        auto eq = pair.find('=');\\n        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;\\n        std::string key = pair.substr(0, eq);\\n        long long val = std::atoll(pair.substr(eq + 1).c_str());\\n        if (key == \\\"ticksize\\\") meta.ticksize = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"ref_price\\\") meta.ref_price = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"band\\\") meta.band = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"min_volume\\\") meta.min_volume = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"max_volume\\\") meta.max_volume = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"position_limit\\\") meta.position_limit = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"max_tps\\\") meta.max_tps = val;\\n        else if (key == \\\"last_traded_price\\\") meta.last_traded_price = val;\\n    }\\n    return meta;\\n}\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Per-instrument state\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstruct InstrumentState {\\n    std::string feed;\\n    InstrumentMeta meta;\\n\\n    // Latest BBO snapshot. -1 means \\\"no quote on that side\\\".\\n    long long bidPx = -1, bidVol = -1, askPx = -1, askVol = -1;\\n\\n    // --- Rolling lookback window for realized vol / z-score ---\\n    // Sized in number of mid-price samples, not wall-clock time. Since BBO\\n    // update frequency isn't constant, a fixed sample count gives a more\\n    // stable window than a fixed time span would.\\n    std::deque<double> priceWindow;\\n    size_t lookback = 200;\\n    double rollingMean = 0.0;\\n    double rollingStd = 0.0;\\n    double zscore = 0.0;\\n\\n    // --- Adaptive strategy parameters ---\\n    // Set at recalibration time only (startup + loss-triggered), not on\\n    // every tick, to avoid chasing noise. spreadMultiplier scales realized\\n    // vol into a half-spread; skewPerUnitInventory scales our own position\\n    // into a fair-value shift that leans against further accumulation.\\n    double spreadMultiplier = 2.0;\\n    long long minSpreadTicks = 2;\\n    double skewPerUnitInventory = 0.0;\\n\\n    // --- Position & PnL (from our own fills only) ---\\n    long long position = 0;\\n    double avgEntryPrice = 0.0;\\n    double realizedPnL = 0.0;       // lifetime, informational\\n    double pnlSinceRecalib = 0.0;   // reset at every recalibration\\n    std::set<std::string> seenMatchIds; // avoid double-processing a fill\\n\\n    // --- Resting order bookkeeping (one bid, one ask per instrument) ---\\n    std::string restingBidId, restingAskId;\\n    long long restingBidPx = -1, restingAskPx = -1;\\n    long long orderSeq = 0;\\n\\n    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastRequote{};\\n};\\n\\nstatic std::map<std::string, InstrumentState> instruments;\\nstatic std::mutex instrumentsMutex;\\n\\nstatic std::ofstream logFile;\\nstatic std::mutex logMutex;\\n\\n// Dedicated PnL/loss log, separate from the raw market-data dump above so\\n// you can actually eyeball or plot PnL without filtering out BBO/MD noise.\\nstatic std::ofstream pnlFile;\\nstatic std::mutex pnlMutex;\\n\\nstatic natsConnection* gConn = nullptr;\\nstatic std::string gSender;\\n\\n// ============================================================================\\n// Small helpers\\n// ============================================================================\\n\\nstatic std::vector<std::string> splitFields(const char* data, int len) {\\n    std::string payload(data, len);\\n    std::stringstream ss(payload);\\n    std::vector<std::string> fields;\\n    std::string word;\\n    while (ss >> word) fields.push_back(word);\\n    return fields;\\n}\\n\\nstatic void writeRow(const char* sourceTag, const char* subject,\\n                      const std::vector<std::string>& fields) {\\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(logMutex);\\n    logFile << sourceTag << \\\",\\\" << subject;\\n    for (const auto& f : fields) logFile << \\\",\\\" << f;\\n    logFile << \\\"\\\\n\\\";\\n    logFile.flush();\\n}\\n\\n// \\\"SENDER:ORDERID\\\" -> SENDER\\nstatic std::string senderOf(const std::string& partyTag) {\\n    auto colon = partyTag.find(':');\\n    return (colon == std::string::npos) ? partyTag : partyTag.substr(0, colon);\\n}\\n\\n// std::clamp
