Used for the DRIVER's fair value\n// throughout -- piggybacks are priced off rel, not their own microprice.\nstatic double fairValue(const InstrumentState& st) {\n    if (st.bidPx < 0 && st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.meta.ref_price);\n    if (st.bidPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.askPx);\n    if (st.askPx < 0) return static_cast<double>(st.bidPx);\n\n    long long tick = st.meta.ticksize > 0 ? st.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    long long spreadTicks = (st.askPx - st.bidPx) / tick;\n    if (spreadTicks >= 2 || st.bidVol <= 0 || st.askVol <= 0) {\n        return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) + static_cast<double>(st.askPx)) / 2.0;\n    }\n    return (static_cast<double>(st.bidPx) * st.askVol + static_cast<double>(st.askPx) * st.bidVol) /\n           static_cast<double>(st.bidVol + st.askVol);\n}\n\n// True if the resting order currently sitting at instrument `st`'s best\n// price on `side` ('B' or 'S') is owned by `sender`.\nstatic bool bestPriceOwnedBy(const InstrumentState& st, char side, const std::string& sender) {\n    if (sender.empty()) return false;\n    long long px = (side == 'B') ? st.bidPx : st.askPx;\n    if (px < 0) return false;\n    for (const auto& kv : st.liveOrders) {\n        const RestingOrder& ord = kv.second;\n        if (ord.side == side && ord.price == px && ord.sender == sender) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// \u00a73.3 escape hatch, option (a): best price on `side` excluding orders owned\n// by `excludeSender`. Returns -1 if no such level exists (e.g. the mover is\n// the only resting order on that side).\nstatic long long bestPriceExcludingSender(const InstrumentState& st, char side,\n                                           const std::string& excludeSender) {\n    bool haveAny = false;\n    long long best = 0;\n    for (const auto& kv : st.liveOrders) {\n        const RestingOrder& ord = kv.second;\n        if (ord.side != side || ord.sender == excludeSender) continue;\n        if (!haveAny) {\n            best = ord.price;\n            haveAny = true;\n        } else if (side == 'B') {\n            best = std::max(best, ord.price);  // best bid = highest price\n        } else {\n            best = std::min(best, ord.price);  // best ask = lowest price\n        }\n    }\n    return haveAny ? best : -1;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Discovery: pairwise lagged correlation (\u00a72.2) -- unchanged math from the\n// previous iteration; what changes is what's allowed to act on the result\n// (see runDiscoveryPass below).\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct PairFit {\n    double r2 = 0.0;\n    long long lag = 0;\n    bool aLeadsB = true;\n};\n\nstatic PairFit bestFit(const InstrumentState& a, const InstrumentState& b) {\n    PairFit best;\n    for (int dir = 0; dir < 2; ++dir) {\n        const auto& lead = (dir == 0) ? a.midHistory : b.midHistory;\n        const auto& lagging = (dir == 0) ? b.midHistory : a.midHistory;\n        for (long long lag = 0; lag <= cfg::kMaxLagNanos; lag += cfg::kLagStepNanos) {\n            std::vector<double> xs, ys;\n            xs.reserve(lagging.size());\n            ys.reserve(lagging.size());\n            for (const auto& p : lagging) {\n                double leadVal;\n                if (valueAtOrBefore(lead, p.first - lag, leadVal)) {\n                    xs.push_back(leadVal);\n                    ys.push_back(p.second);\n                }\n            }\n            if (static_cast<int>(xs.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) continue;\n            double r = pearsonR(xs, ys);\n            double r2 = r * r;\n            if (r2 > best.r2) {\n                best.r2 = r2;\n                best.lag = lag;\n                best.aLeadsB = (dir == 0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\n\nstruct UnionFind {\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> parent;\n    std::string find(const std::string& x) {\n        auto it = parent.find(x);\n        if (it == parent.end()) {\n            parent[x] = x;\n            return x;\n        }\n        if (it->second == x) return x;\n        std::string root = find(it->second);\n        parent[x] = root;\n        return root;\n    }\n    void unite(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {\n        std::string ra = find(a), rb = find(b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n};\n\nstatic std::string clusterSignature(std::vector<std::string> members) {\n    std::sort(members.begin(), members.end());\n    std::ostringstream oss;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < members.size(); ++i) {\n        if (i) oss << \",\";\n        oss << members[i];\n    }\n    return oss.str();\n}\n\nstatic void publishPairing(const std::string& piggyback, const std::string& driver, double rel) {\n    if (!gDeskKv) return;\n    std::ostringstream oss;\n    oss << \"driver=\" << driver << \";rel=\" << rel << \";ready=true\";\n    uint64_t rev = 0;\n    natsStatus s = kvStore_PutString(&rev, gDeskKv, piggyback.c_str(), oss.str().c_str());\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] failed to publish pairing to DESK_STATE: %s\\n\", piggyback.c_str(),\n               natsStatus_GetText(s));\n    }\n}\n\n// \u00a72.3 + \u00a72.4: cluster membership must be stable for kClusterStablePasses\n// consecutive passes before it locks; driver dominance must then *also* be\n// unambiguous for kDriverStablePasses consecutive passes before it locks.\n// Both locks are permanent -- a locked cluster is removed from all the\n// bookkeeping above (gClusterStability / gDriverCandidateStability) so it\n// can never be revisited or relabeled.\nstatic void runDiscoveryPass() {\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n\n    std::vector<std::string> feeds;\n    feeds.reserve(gInstruments.size());\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) feeds.push_back(kv.first);\n\n    UnionFind uf;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < feeds.size(); ++i) {\n        // Already-locked feeds are frozen: skip them entirely, both as a\n        // source and target of new pairwise relationships.\n        if (gFeedClusterSignature.count(feeds[i])) continue;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < feeds.size(); ++j) {\n            if (gFeedClusterSignature.count(feeds[j])) continue;\n            InstrumentState& A = gInstruments[feeds[i]];\n            InstrumentState& B = gInstruments[feeds[j]];\n            if (static_cast<int>(A.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints ||\n                static_cast<int>(B.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            PairFit f = bestFit(A, B);\n            if (f.r2 >= cfg::kR2Floor) {\n                uf.unite(feeds[i], feeds[j]);\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PAIR_RELATED,\" << feeds[i] << \"-\" << feeds[j]\n                                  << \",r2=\" << f.r2 << \";lag=\" << f.lag\n                                  << \";aLeadsB=\" << (f.aLeadsB ? 1 : 0) << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> components;\n    for (auto& feed : feeds) {\n        if (gFeedClusterSignature.count(feed)) continue;  // frozen, not part of this pass's churn\n        if (uf.parent.count(feed)) components[uf.find(feed)].push_back(feed);\n    }\n\n    // -- \u00a72.3: cluster lock debounce --\n    std::set<std::string> currentSignatures;\n    for (auto& kv : components) {\n        std::vector<std::string>& members = kv.second;\n        if (members.size() < 2) continue;\n        std::string sig = clusterSignature(members);\n        currentSignatures.insert(sig);\n        int& count = gClusterStability[sig];\n        count++;\n        if (count >= cfg::kClusterStablePasses && !gLockedClusterSignatures.count(sig)) {\n            gLockedClusterSignatures.insert(sig);\n            for (auto& f : members) gFeedClusterSignature[f] = sig;\n            printf(\"CLUSTER LOCKED: %s\\n\", sig.c_str());\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",CLUSTER_LOCKED,\" << sig << \",\\n\";\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Any signature not observed this pass had its membership change --\n    // its stability streak is broken, reset it so a stale count can't\n    // later combine with an unrelated future streak.\n    for (auto it = gClusterStability.begin(); it != gClusterStability.end();) {\n        if (!currentSignatures.count(it->first)) it = gClusterStability.erase(it);\n        else ++it;\n    }\n\n    // -- \u00a72.4: driver identification, debounced, only within locked clusters\n    //    that don't already have a driver locked --\n    for (const std::string& sig : gLockedClusterSignatures) {\n        if (gDriverLockedSignatures.count(sig)) continue;  // frozen already\n\n        std::vector<std::string> members;\n        for (auto& kv : gFeedClusterSignature) {\n            if (kv.second == sig) members.push_back(kv.first);\n        }\n\n        std::string bestFeed, bestSender;\n        double bestFrac = 0.0;\n        int strongCount = 0;\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            InstrumentState& st = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (st.totalTrades < cfg::kTradeWarmup) continue;\n            std::string domSender;\n            long long domCount = 0;\n            for (auto& sc : st.senderTradeCount) {\n                if (sc.second > domCount) {\n                    domCount = sc.second;\n                    domSender = sc.first;\n                }\n            }\n            double frac = st.totalTrades > 0 ? static_cast<double>(domCount) / st.totalTrades : 0.0;\n            if (frac >= cfg::kDominanceFloor) {\n                strongCount++;\n                if (frac > bestFrac) {\n                    bestFrac = frac;\n                    bestFeed = feed;\n                    bestSender = domSender;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (strongCount != 1) {\n            // Ambiguous or nobody dominant yet -- reset the debounce\n            // counter rather than let a stale streak carry through a\n            // momentary flicker.\n            gDriverCandidateStability.erase(sig);\n            if (strongCount > 1 && gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER,\" << sig << \",\\n\";\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        auto& cand = gDriverCandidateStability[sig];\n        if (cand.first == bestFeed) {\n            cand.second++;\n        } else {\n            cand.first = bestFeed;\n            cand.second = 1;\n        }\n\n        if (cand.second >= cfg::kDriverStablePasses) {\n            InstrumentState& driverSt = gInstruments[bestFeed];\n            driverSt.isDriver = true;\n            driverSt.moverSender = bestSender;\n            gDriverLockedSignatures.insert(sig);\n            printf(\"DRIVER LOCKED: %s, mover=%s\\n\", bestFeed.c_str(), bestSender.c_str());\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",DRIVER_LOCKED,\" << bestFeed\n                              << \",mover=\" << bestSender << \";frac=\" << bestFrac << \"\\n\";\n            }\n            for (auto& feed : members) {\n                if (feed == bestFeed) continue;\n                InstrumentState& pig = gInstruments[feed];\n                pig.isPiggyback = true;\n                pig.driverFeed = bestFeed;\n                // \u00a73.1: sample collection starts fresh, live, forward-only\n                // from the moment of lock -- do not reuse anything from the\n                // discovery-phase history above, it was never filtered for\n                // mover contamination.\n                pig.relSamples.clear();\n                pig.relSamplesSeenTotal = 0;\n                pig.relTrusted = false;\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PIGGYBACK_LOCKED,\" << feed\n                                  << \",driver=\" << bestFeed << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n            gDriverCandidateStability.erase(sig);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a73: Offset (rel) recovery -- burst-triggered, contamination-guarded\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Updates \u00a73.2/\u00a73.3 \"how long has the mover held the current best price\"\n// tracking for one side. Call after bidPx/askPx are updated and liveOrders\n// is current for this instrument.\nstatic void updateMoverOwnershipTimer(InstrumentState& pig, const std::string& mover) {\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    if (mover.empty()) return;\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', mover)) {\n        if (pig.lastMoverBidPx != pig.bidPx) {\n            pig.moverBidSince = nowTp;\n            pig.lastMoverBidPx = pig.bidPx;\n        }\n    } else {\n        pig.lastMoverBidPx = -2;\n    }\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', mover)) {\n        if (pig.lastMoverAskPx != pig.askPx) {\n            pig.moverAskSince = nowTp;\n            pig.lastMoverAskPx = pig.askPx;\n        }\n    } else {\n        pig.lastMoverAskPx = -2;\n    }\n}\n\n// Attempts one rel sample from a detected requote burst. Returns having\n// either taken a sample (adding to relSamples / possibly trusting) or\n// having skipped, per the contamination rules in \u00a73.2/\u00a73.3.\nstatic void attemptRelSample(InstrumentState& pig, long long burstTs) {\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n    if (pig.bidPx < 0 || pig.askPx < 0) return;\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    long long effBid = pig.bidPx, effAsk = pig.askPx;\n\n    bool moverOnBid = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool moverOnAsk = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    if (moverOnBid) {\n        bool stale = (nowTp - pig.moverBidSince) >= cfg::kContaminationTimeout;\n        if (!stale) return;  // \u00a73.2: active contamination, skip entirely\n        long long alt = bestPriceExcludingSender(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n        if (alt < 0) return;  // \u00a73.3(a): no fallback level available, skip\n        effBid = alt;\n    }\n    if (moverOnAsk) {\n        bool stale = (nowTp - pig.moverAskSince) >= cfg::kContaminationTimeout;\n        if (!stale) return;\n        long long alt = bestPriceExcludingSender(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n        if (alt < 0) return;\n        effAsk = alt;\n    }\n\n    // Anchor to fv(driver) as of the burst's own wire timestamp, not\n    // whatever gInstruments[driverFeed] currently holds -- ex.bbo.<driver>\n    // and ex.md.<piggyback>.* are separate NATS subjects with no\n    // cross-subject ordering guarantee, so \"live\" driver state can already\n    // be one or more ticks ahead of what the LP actually saw when it\n    // repriced. valueAtOrBefore gives the causally-correct fv instead.\n    double driverFv;\n    if (!valueAtOrBefore(drv.midHistory, burstTs, driverFv)) return;  // no anchored driver fv yet\n    double center = (static_cast<double>(effBid) + static_cast<double>(effAsk)) / 2.0;\n    double sample = center - driverFv;\n\n    pig.relSamples.push_back(sample);\n    while (pig.relSamples.size() > cfg::kRelWindow) pig.relSamples.pop_front();\n    pig.relSamplesSeenTotal++;\n\n    if (!pig.relTrusted) {\n        printf(\"REL SAMPLE #%lld = %.4f\\n\", pig.relSamplesSeenTotal, sample);\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relSamples.size() < cfg::kRelMinSamples) return;\n    printf(\"beginning mean and std calculation!\\n\");\n    std::vector<double> v(pig.relSamples.begin(), pig.relSamples.end());\n    double m = meanOf(v);\n    double var = 0.0;\n    for (double x : v) var += (x - m) * (x - m);\n    var /= static_cast<double>(v.size());\n    double sd = std::sqrt(var);\n    long long driverTick = drv.meta.ticksize > 0 ? drv.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double sdTicks = sd / static_cast<double>(driverTick);\n    printf(\"sdTicks = %.2f\", sdTicks, \"\\n\");\n\n    bool wasTrusted = pig.relTrusted;\n    if (sdTicks < cfg::kRelTrustStdTicks) {\n        pig.rel = m;\n        pig.relTrusted = true;\n    }\n    // Note: once trusted, we don't revoke trust on a later noisy sample --\n    // \u00a73.4 doesn't ask for that, and doing so would reopen the door to\n    // exactly the kind of instability the fixed-offset design in \u00a75 is\n    // trying to avoid. New samples still accumulate and refine `rel`.\n\n    if (pig.relTrusted && !wasTrusted) {\n        publishPairing(pig.feed, pig.driverFeed, pig.rel);\n        printf(\"REL TRUSTED: driver=%s rel=%.4f sdTicks=%.3f\\n\", pig.driverFeed.c_str(), pig.rel,\n               sdTicks);\n        printf(\"LIVE - quoting %s\\n\", pig.feed.c_str());\n        if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n            gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",REL_TRUSTED,\" << pig.feed << \",driver=\" << pig.driverFeed\n                          << \";rel=\" << pig.rel << \";sdTicks=\" << sdTicks << \"\\n\";\n        }\n    } else if (pig.relTrusted) {\n        // Refine the published rel as more samples come in, without\n        // reprinting REL TRUSTED / LIVE again.\n        publishPairing(pig.feed, pig.driverFeed, pig.rel);\n    }\n}\n\n// \u00a73.1: called on every A/C for this piggyback's own book. Detects a\n// requote burst -- a batch of cancels immediately followed by a batch of\n// adds, spanning both book sides, all from ONE sender -- and, on\n// detection, attempts exactly one rel sample.\n//\n// Grouping by sender (rather than pooling \"any sender\" together, as this\n// used to) matters for two reasons: (1) it makes a detected burst mean\n// \"one LP actor re-quoting,\" not incidental overlap of unrelated senders'\n// unrelated cancels/adds landing in the same window; (2) it lets us\n// exclude `moverSender` outright -- if the mover itself is touching this\n// book, any resulting churn isn't the LP repricing signal we're after,\n// it's the contamination case we already know can happen, so we skip it\n// at detection time rather than relying solely on the top-of-book\n// contamination guard in attemptRelSample.\n//\n// The anchor for the fv lookup is the wire timestamp of this sender's\n// FIRST cancel in the qualifying sequence, not the completing 'A' -- that\n// is the earliest point at which this sender is known to be reacting, so\n// it's the tightest causally-safe anchor available.\nstatic void noteBookEventAndCheckBurst(InstrumentState& pig, char msgType, long long wireTs,\n                                        const std::string& sender, char side) {\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback) return;\n    if (sender.empty()) return;  // can't group what we can't attribute\n\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    const std::string moverSender =\n        (itDriver != gInstruments.end()) ? itDriver->second.moverSender : std::string();\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    SenderBurstTracker& tr = pig.senderBursts[sender];\n\n    auto prune = [&](std::deque<BurstEvent>& dq) {\n        while (!dq.empty() && nowTp - dq.front().localTime > cfg::kBurstWindow) dq.pop_front();\n    };\n\n    if (msgType == 'C') {\n        tr.recentCancels.push_back({nowTp, wireTs, side});\n        prune(tr.recentCancels);\n        return;\n    }\n    if (msgType != 'A') return;\n\n    tr.recentAdds.push_back({nowTp, wireTs, side});\n    prune(tr.recentAdds);\n    prune(tr.recentCancels);\n\n    if (sender == moverSender) return;  // exclude the identified mover explicitly\n\n    bool enoughCancels = static_cast<int>(tr.recentCancels.size()) >= cfg::kBurstMinCancels;\n    bool enoughAdds = static_cast<int>(tr.recentAdds.size()) >= cfg::kBurstMinAdds;\n    bool cooledDown = (nowTp - tr.lastBurstSampleAttempt) >= cfg::kBurstCooldown;\n\n    bool sawBid = false, sawAsk = false;\n    for (const auto& e : tr.recentCancels) { sawBid |= (e.side == 'B'); sawAsk |= (e.side == 'S'); }\n    for (const auto& e : tr.recentAdds)     { sawBid |= (e.side == 'B'); sawAsk |= (e.side == 'S'); }\n    bool spansBothSides = sawBid && sawAsk;\n\n    if (enoughCancels && enoughAdds && spansBothSides && cooledDown) {\n        tr.lastBurstSampleAttempt = nowTp;\n        long long anchorTs = tr.recentCancels.front().wireTs;  // this sender's first cancel in the sequence\n        attemptRelSample(pig, anchorTs);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a74: continuous driver fair-value tracking\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Called on every market-data event (BBO change or trade) for a driver\n// instrument. Recomputes fv(driver) and, if it differs from the value last\n// used to quote, reprices every live dependent piggyback immediately.\n// Forward-declared here, defined after requoteInstrument below.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st, std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock);\n\n// `lock` is the caller's already-held std::unique_lock on gMutex (same one\n// the caller got from onBBO/onMD). Passed straight through to\n// requoteInstrument, which unlocks/relocks it internally around its own\n// network round trip -- see requoteInstrument for why this is safe to do\n// repeatedly across several dependents in this loop rather than a deadlock\n// risk: it's the same lock object being handed down, not a fresh lock.\nstatic void checkDriverFvUpdate(InstrumentState& drv, std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock) {\n    if (!drv.isDriver) return;\n    double newFv = fairValue(drv);\n\n    if (drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv && newFv == drv.lastUsedDriverFv) return;  // unchanged, nothing to do\n\n    double oldFv = drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv ? drv.lastUsedDriverFv : newFv;\n    bool first = !drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv;\n    drv.lastUsedDriverFv = newFv;\n    drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv = true;\n    if (first) return;  // nothing to reprice yet on the very first observation\n\n    std::vector<std::string> dependents;\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) {\n        if (kv.second.isPiggyback && kv.second.driverFeed == drv.feed && kv.second.relTrusted) {\n            dependents.push_back(kv.first);\n        }\n    }\n    if (dependents.empty()) return;\n\n    std::ostringstream depList;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < dependents.size(); ++i) {\n        if (i) depList << \",\";\n        depList << dependents[i];\n    }\n    printf(\"DRIVER FV UPDATED: %s old=%.4f new=%.4f -> repricing %s\\n\", drv.feed.c_str(), oldFv, newFv,\n           depList.str().c_str());\n\n    for (auto& feed : dependents) {\n        requoteInstrument(gInstruments.at(feed), lock);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a75: Quoting\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DesiredQuote {\n    bool haveBid = false, haveAsk = false;\n    long long bidPx = 0, askPx = 0;\n    long long bidVol = 0, askVol = 0;\n};\n\nstatic void printBlockedTransition(InstrumentState& pig, char side, bool nowBlocked,\n                                    const std::string& reason) {\n    bool& flag = (side == 'B') ? pig.bidBlocked : pig.askBlocked;\n    const char* label = (side == 'B') ? \"BID\" : \"ASK\";\n    if (nowBlocked && !flag) {\n        printf(\"%s blocked: %s (%s)\\n\", label, pig.feed.c_str(), reason.c_str());\n    } else if (!nowBlocked && flag) {\n        printf(\"%s unblocked: %s\\n\", label, pig.feed.c_str());\n    }\n    flag = nowBlocked;\n}\n\n// Drivers are never quoted. Only piggybacks with a trusted rel get quotes,\n// priced at c = fv(driver) + rel, fixed +/-N ticks (\u00a75) -- not ratcheted to\n// any historical extreme.\nstatic DesiredQuote computeQuotes(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    DesiredQuote q;\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback || !pig.relTrusted) return q;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return q;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = driverFv + pig.rel;\n\n    long long tick = pig.meta.ticksize > 0 ? pig.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    long long halfSpread = cfg::kQuoteHalfSpreadTicks * tick;\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(center / tick)) * tick - halfSpread;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(center / tick)) * tick + halfSpread;\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n\n    // meta.band restricts how far from ref_price quotes may sit -- clamp\n    // into it, and warn once if the fixed half-spread doesn't fit.\n    if (pig.meta.band > 0) {\n        long long lo = pig.meta.ref_price - pig.meta.band;\n        long long hi = pig.meta.ref_price + pig.meta.band;\n        if ((hi - lo) < 2 * halfSpread && !pig.bandWarningPrinted) {\n            printf(\"WARNING: %s meta.band (+/-%lld) is narrower than the configured quote \"\n                   \"half-spread (%lld); quotes will be clamped into the band.\\n\",\n                   pig.feed.c_str(), pig.meta.band, halfSpread);\n            pig.bandWarningPrinted = true;\n        }\n        bidPx = std::max(bidPx, lo);\n        askPx = std::min(askPx, hi);\n        if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n    }\n\n    long long size = std::max<long long>(pig.meta.min_volume, 1);  // \u00a70: flat size, deliberate for this test\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    bool bidPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseBidUntil;\n    bool askPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseAskUntil;\n    bool bidMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool askMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    bool bidBlocked = bidPaused || bidMoverOwned;\n    bool askBlocked = askPaused || askMoverOwned;\n    printBlockedTransition(pig, 'B', bidBlocked, bidPaused ? \"fill-burst pause\" : \"mover owns level\");\n    printBlockedTransition(pig, 'S', askBlocked, askPaused ? \"fill-burst pause\" : \"mover owns level\");\n\n    if (!bidBlocked) {\n        q.haveBid = true;\n        q.bidPx = bidPx;\n        q.bidVol = size;\n    }\n    if (!askBlocked) {\n        q.haveAsk = true;\n        q.askPx = askPx;\n        q.askVol = size;\n    }\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry -- wire format confirmed against PROTOCOL.md, unchanged.\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId, char side,\n                      long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(),\n             orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s C %s %s\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), orderId.c_str());\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] cancelOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> X <FEED> <side> <price>\" -- cancels whatever of our own\n// orders are resting on that side at that price in one round trip. Used\n// instead of single-order cancelOrder()/C in requoteInstrument's network\n// phase per requote_fix_instructions.md step 2: fewer round trips, and it\n// also cleans up any order left resting from a stale (since-superseded)\n// requote attempt whose write-back was discarded in step 3, since that\n// order is targeted by side+price rather than by an id we may no longer\n// have on hand.\nstatic bool bulkCancelSide(const std::string& feed, char side, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s X %s %c %lld\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), side, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] bulkCancelSide request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    char buf[9];\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), (st.orderSeq++) % 10000);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Everything requoteInstrument's step 1 needs to hand off to the unlocked\n// network phase (step 2), and back to the write-back phase (step 3).\nstruct RequotePlan {\n    long long version = 0;\n    std::string feed;\n\n    bool doCancelBid = false, doCancelAsk = false;\n    long long cancelBidPx = -1, cancelAskPx = -1;\n\n    bool doAddBid = false, doAddAsk = false;\n    std::string addBidId, addAskId;\n    long long addBidPx = 0, addBidVol = 0;\n    long long addAskPx = 0, addAskVol = 0;\n};\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs from what's\n// currently resting. Called both reactively (the instant something that\n// should move our price happens -- \u00a74's driver-fv-change trigger, plus a\n// piggyback's own book events) and from a bounded safety-net loop.\n//\n// The caller holds `lock` (a std::unique_lock on gMutex) on entry, exactly\n// as it would have held a lock_guard before this fix -- none of the four\n// call sites are restructured, they just pass a unique_lock instead of a\n// lock_guard so it CAN be released mid-scope. What changes is entirely\n// inside this function: step 1 reads/computes with `lock` held (already\n// true on entry), step 2 releases that same lock for the blocking NATS\n// round trip -- the actual source of the delay -- and step 3 reacquires it\n// before writing anything back. `lock` is guaranteed held again on every\n// return path, so the caller gets it back exactly as it would have from a\n// lock_guard-scoped call, just without gMutex being held for the network\n// round trip in between.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st, std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock) {\n    // -- Step 1: read + compute, snapshot into plan. `lock` already held. --\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    if (nowTp - st.lastRequote < cfg::kMinRequoteInterval) return;\n    st.lastRequote = nowTp;\n\n    DesiredQuote q = computeQuotes(st);\n    RequotePlan plan;\n    plan.version = ++st.requoteVersion;\n    plan.feed = st.feed;\n\n    bool wantBid = q.haveBid;\n    bool needNewBid = wantBid && (st.restingBidId.empty() || st.restingBidPx != q.bidPx ||\n                                   st.restingBidRemaining != q.bidVol);\n    if (!wantBid && !st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n        plan.doCancelBid = true;\n        plan.cancelBidPx = st.restingBidPx;\n        st.restingBidId.clear();\n        st.restingBidPx = -1;\n        st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n    } else if (needNewBid) {\n        if (!st.restingBidId.empty()) {\n            plan.doCancelBid = true;\n            plan.cancelBidPx = st.restingBidPx;\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        plan.doAddBid = true;\n        plan.addBidId = nextOrderId(st);\n        plan.addBidPx = q.bidPx;\n        plan.addBidVol = q.bidVol;\n    }\n\n    bool wantAsk = q.haveAsk;\n    bool needNewAsk = wantAsk && (st.restingAskId.empty() || st.restingAskPx != q.askPx ||\n                                   st.restingAskRemaining != q.askVol);\n    if (!wantAsk && !st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n        plan.doCancelAsk = true;\n        plan.cancelAskPx = st.restingAskPx;\n        st.restingAskId.clear();\n        st.restingAskPx = -1;\n        st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n    } else if (needNewAsk) {\n        if (!st.restingAskId.empty()) {\n            plan.doCancelAsk = true;\n            plan.cancelAskPx = st.restingAskPx;\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        plan.doAddAsk = true;\n        plan.addAskId = nextOrderId(st);\n        plan.addAskPx = q.askPx;\n        plan.addAskVol = q.askVol;\n    }\n\n    // -- Step 2: release the caller's lock, do the blocking NATS round\n    //    trip, reacquire it. Bulk cancel-by-side (X) instead of sequential\n    //    single-order cancels. --\n    lock.unlock();\n    if (plan.doCancelBid) bulkCancelSide(plan.feed, 'B', plan.cancelBidPx);\n    if (plan.doCancelAsk) bulkCancelSide(plan.feed, 'S', plan.cancelAskPx);\n\n    bool bidAdded = false, askAdded = false;\n    if (plan.doAddBid) bidAdded = addOrder(plan.feed, plan.addBidId, 'B', plan.addBidVol, plan.addBidPx);\n    if (plan.doAddAsk) askAdded = addOrder(plan.feed, plan.addAskId, 'S', plan.addAskVol, plan.addAskPx);\n    lock.lock();\n\n    // -- Step 3: stale-reply guard, then write back, still under `lock`. --\n    if (st.requoteVersion != plan.version) {\n        // A newer requote for this instrument started (and may already\n        // have sent its own cancel/add) while we were unlocked -- discard\n        // our result rather than overwrite whatever it wrote. Any order we\n        // just added is not lost: it's targeted by side+price via\n        // bulkCancelSide the next time this instrument is requoted, not by\n        // an id we'd need to have kept around.\n        return;\n    }\n    if (bidAdded) {\n        st.restingBidId = plan.addBidId;\n        st.restingBidPx = plan.addBidPx;\n        st.restingBidRemaining = plan.addBidVol;\n    }\n    if (askAdded) {\n        st.restingAskId = plan.addAskId;\n        st.restingAskPx = plan.addAskPx;\n        st.restingAskRemaining = plan.addAskVol;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// PnL logging\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void writePnlRow(const std::string& eventType, InstrumentState& st, const std::string& side,\n                         long long fillPrice, long long fillVolume, const std::string& counterparty,\n                         const std::string& role) {\n    double mid = fairValue(st);\n    double unrealized = 0.0;\n    if (st.position != 0) {\n        unrealized = (st.position > 0) ? ((mid - st.avgEntryPrice) * st.position)\n                                        : ((st.avgEntryPrice - mid) * (-st.position));\n    }\n    double total = st.realizedPnL + unrealized;\n    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> logLock(gLogMutex);\n    gPnlFile << nowNanos() << \",\" << eventType << \",\" << st.feed << \",\" << side << \",\" << fillPrice\n             << \",\" << fillVolume << \",\" << counterparty << \",\" << role << \",\" << st.position << \",\"\n             << st.avgEntryPrice << \",\" << mid << \",\" << st.meta.ref_price << \",\" << st.realizedPnL\n             << \",\" << unrealized << \",\" << total << \"\\n\";\n    gPnlFile.flush();\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Fill application (running-average cost method)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void applyFill(InstrumentState& st, char ourSide, long long price, long long volume) {\n    long long signedVol = (ourSide == 'B') ? volume : -volume;\n    long long newPosition = st.position + signedVol;\n\n    bool sameDirectionOrFlat =\n        (st.position >= 0 && signedVol > 0) || (st.position <= 0 && signedVol < 0) || st.position == 0;\n    if (sameDirectionOrFlat) {\n        double totalCost = st.avgEntryPrice * std::llabs(st.position) + static_cast<double>(price) * volume;\n        st.avgEntryPrice = std::llabs(newPosition) > 0 ? totalCost / std::llabs(newPosition) : 0.0;\n    } else {\n        long long closingVol = std::min(std::llabs(signedVol), std::llabs(st.position));\n        double pnlPerUnit = (st.position > 0) ? (static_cast<double>(price) - st.avgEntryPrice)\n                                               : (st.avgEntryPrice - static_cast<double>(price));\n        st.realizedPnL += pnlPerUnit * closingVol;\n        if (std::llabs(signedVol) > std::llabs(st.position)) {\n            st.avgEntryPrice = static_cast<double>(price);\n        }\n    }\n    st.position = newPosition;\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    auto& times = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.bidFillTimes : st.askFillTimes;\n    times.push_back(nowTp);\n    while (!times.empty() && nowTp - times.front() > cfg::kFillBurstWindow) times.pop_front();\n    if (static_cast<int>(times.size()) >= cfg::kFillBurstThreshold) {\n        auto& pauseUntil = (ourSide == 'B') ? st.pauseBidUntil : st.pauseAskUntil;\n        pauseUntil = nowTp + cfg::kFillBurstCooldown;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Market data callbacks\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void onBBO(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc;\n    (void)sub;\n    (void)closure;\n    std::string payload(natsMsg_GetData(msg), natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg));\n    auto fields = split(payload, ' ');\n    // <ts> <FEED> <bid_px> <bid_vol> <ask_px> <ask_vol>\n    if (fields.size() != 6) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    long long ts = std::atoll(fields[0].c_str());\n    std::string feed = fields[1];\n    auto parseOr = [](const std::string& s) -> long long {\n        return (s == \"-\") ? -1 : std::atoll(s.c_str());\n    };\n    long long bidPx = parseOr(fields[2]);\n    long long bidVol = parseOr(fields[3]);\n    long long askPx = parseOr(fields[4]);\n    long long askVol = parseOr(fields[5]);\n\n    // unique_lock (not lock_guard) so requoteInstrument can release and\n    // reacquire this exact lock internally around its network round trip,\n    // per requote_fix_instructions.md -- this call site's own logic and\n    // lock ordering is otherwise unchanged.\n    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n    auto it = gInstruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == gInstruments.end()) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    st.bidPx = bidPx;\n    st.bidVol = bidVol;\n    st.askPx = askPx;\n    st.askVol = askVol;\n\n    double fv = fairValue(st);\n    st.midHistory.push_back({ts, fv});\n    while (st.midHistory.size() > cfg::kMidHistoryCap) st.midHistory.pop_front();\n\n    if (st.isPiggyback) {\n        auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(st.driverFeed);\n        if (itDriver != gInstruments.end()) {\n            updateMoverOwnershipTimer(st, itDriver->second.moverSender);\n        }\n        if (st.relTrusted) requoteInstrument(st, lock);\n    } else if (st.isDriver) {\n        // \u00a74: every market-data event on the driver re-checks fv, including\n        // plain BBO moves (not just trades).\n        checkDriverFvUpdate(st, lock);\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\nstatic void onMD(natsConnection* nc, natsSubscription* sub, natsMsg* msg, void* closure) {\n    (void)nc;\n    (void)sub;\n    (void)closure;\n    std::string payload(natsMsg_GetData(msg), natsMsg_GetDataLength(msg));\n    const char* subject = natsMsg_GetSubject(msg);\n\n    auto fields = split(payload, ' ');\n    if (fields.size() < 2) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    std::string type = fields[1];\n    // Every onMD message type is \"<ts> <TYPE> ...\", so fields[0] is always\n    // the wire timestamp. Parsed here (previously discarded entirely) so\n    // burst-triggered rel sampling can anchor to it instead of to whatever\n    // driver state our own callback happens to see at processing time.\n    long long wireTs = std::atoll(fields[0].c_str());\n\n    // Subject is \"ex.md.<FEED>.<SENDER>\" -- pull the feed from the subject.\n    std::string subj(subject);\n    auto firstDot = subj.find('.');\n    auto secondDot = subj.find('.', firstDot + 1);\n    auto thirdDot = subj.find('.', secondDot + 1);\n    if (secondDot == std::string::npos || thirdDot == std::string::npos) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    std::string feed = subj.substr(secondDot + 1, thirdDot - secondDot - 1);\n\n    // unique_lock (not lock_guard) so requoteInstrument can release and\n    // reacquire this exact lock internally around its network round trip,\n    // per requote_fix_instructions.md -- this call site's own logic and\n    // lock ordering is otherwise unchanged.\n    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);\n    auto it = gInstruments.find(feed);\n    if (it == gInstruments.end()) {\n        natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n        return;\n    }\n    InstrumentState& st = it->second;\n\n    if (type == \"A\") {\n        // <ts> A <id:17> <B|S> <volume> <price>\n        if (fields.size() != 6) {\n            natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n            return;\n        }\n        RestingOrder ord;\n        ord.sender = senderOf(fields[2]);\n        ord.side = fields[3][0];\n        ord.volume = std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n        ord.price = std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n        st.liveOrders[fields[2]] = ord;\n\n        noteBookEventAndCheckBurst(st, 'A', wireTs, ord.sender, ord.side);\n    } else if (type == \"C\") {\n        // <ts> C <id:17>\n        if (fields.size() != 3) {\n            natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n            return;\n        }\n        const std::string& id = fields[2];\n\n        // Need sender/side for burst-grouping, so look it up before erasing.\n        // If we never had this order tracked (e.g. it existed before we\n        // started listening), fall back to parsing sender straight off the\n        // wire id; side is left unknown ' ' in that case, which just means\n        // this one cancel can't by itself satisfy the both-sides check.\n        std::string cancelSender;\n        char cancelSide = ' ';\n        auto itOrd = st.liveOrders.find(id);\n        if (itOrd != st.liveOrders.end()) {\n            cancelSender = itOrd->second.sender;\n            cancelSide = itOrd->second.side;\n        } else {\n            cancelSender = senderOf(id);\n        }\n        st.liveOrders.erase(id);\n\n        noteBookEventAndCheckBurst(st, 'C', wireTs, cancelSender, cancelSide);\n\n        // If this was our own resting order and we still have it tracked\n        // locally, the exchange removed it out from under us -- i.e. it\n        // just got fully filled. React immediately instead of waiting for\n        // the safety-net tick.\n        bool wasOurBid = !st.restingBidId.empty() && id == (gSender + \":\" + st.restingBidId);\n        bool wasOurAsk = !st.restingAskId.empty() && id == (gSender + \":\" + st.restingAskId);\n        if (wasOurBid) {\n            st.restingBidId.clear();\n            st.restingBidPx = -1;\n            st.restingBidRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        if (wasOurAsk) {\n            st.restingAskId.clear();\n            st.restingAskPx = -1;\n            st.restingAskRemaining = 0;\n        }\n        if (wasOurBid || wasOurAsk) {\n            st.lastRequote = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{};  // bypass the throttle once\n            requoteInstrument(st, lock);\n        }\n    } else if (type == \"E\" || type == \"T\") {\n        // <ts> E <incoming:17> <resting:17> <volume> <price> <matchid> <B|S>\n        if (fields.size() != 8) {\n            natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n            return;\n        }\n        const std::string& incoming = fields[2];\n        const std::string& resting = fields[3];\n        long long volume = std::atoll(fields[4].c_str());\n        long long price = std::atoll(fields[5].c_str());\n        const std::string& matchId = fields[6];\n        char aggressorSide = fields[7][0];\n\n        if (type == \"E\") {\n            std::string aggressorSender = senderOf(incoming);\n            st.senderTradeCount[aggressorSender] += 1;\n            st.totalTrades += 1;\n\n            // \u00a74: trades move fair value too (via last_traded_price-style\n            // signals folded into our own microprice through bid/ask vol\n            // shifts, and directly for instruments where fairValue() would\n            // fall back to mid) -- re-check on every trade, not just BBO.\n            if (st.isDriver) checkDriverFvUpdate(st, lock);\n\n            bool weAreIncoming = senderOf(incoming) == gSender;\n            bool weAreResting = senderOf(resting) == gSender;\n            if ((weAreIncoming || weAreResting) && !st.seenMatchIds.count(matchId)) {\n                st.seenMatchIds.insert(matchId);\n                char ourSide;\n                std::string counterpartyId, role;\n                if (weAreResting) {\n                    ourSide = (aggressorSide == 'B') ? 'S' : 'B';\n                    counterpartyId = incoming;\n                    role = \"PASSIVE\";\n                } else {\n                    ourSide = aggressorSide;\n                    counterpartyId = resting;\n                    role = \"AGGRESSIVE\";\n                }\n                applyFill(st, ourSide, price, volume);\n                writePnlRow(\"FILL\", st, std::string(1, ourSide), price, volume,\n                            senderOf(counterpartyId), role);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    natsMsg_Destroy(msg);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Discovery thread\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void discoveryLoop() {\n    while (gRunning.load()) {\n        std::this_thread::sleep_for(cfg::kDiscoveryPassInterval);\n        runDiscoveryPass();\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// main\n// ============================================================================\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    (void)argc;\n    (void)argv;\n\n    gPnlFile.open(envOr(\"PNL_LOG_PATH\", \"/data/pnl.csv\"));\n    if (!gPnlFile.is_open()) {\n        std::cerr << \"failed to open pnl log\\n\";\n        return 1;\n    }\n    gPnlFile << \"ts,event_type,feed,side,fill_price,fill_volume,counterparty,counterparty_role,\"\n                \"position,avg_entry_price,mid,ref_price,realized_pnl,unrealized_pnl,total_pnl\\n\";\n\n    gDiscoveryLog.open(envOr(\"DISCOVERY_LOG_PATH\", \"/data/discovery.csv\"));\n    if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n        gDiscoveryLog << \"ts,event,feed_or_pair,detail\\n\";\n    }\n\n    const char* natsUrl = envOr(\"NATS_URL\", \"nats://localhost:4222\");\n    gSender = envOr(\"SENDER\", \"QUOTER01\");  // 8 chars, per PROTOCOL.md\n\n    printf(\"quoter: connecting to %s as sender=%s\\n\", natsUrl, gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsStatus s = NATS_OK;\n    jsCtx* js = nullptr;\n    kvStore* metaKv = nullptr;\n\n    s = natsConnection_ConnectTo(&gConn, natsUrl);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"connect failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return 1;\n    }\n    printf(\"CONNECTED\\n\");\n\n    s = natsConnection_JetStream(&js, gConn, nullptr);\n    if (s == NATS_OK) s = js_KeyValue(&metaKv, js, \"EX_META\");\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"EX_META KV setup failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    // DESK_STATE: where discovered pairings/offsets are published for the\n    // separate Python hedger process to consume (out of scope here). We\n    // don't attempt to confirm the hedger's own connection from this\n    // process -- it's a separate seat with its own lifecycle -- but the\n    // KV bucket it reads from is set up here so it has somewhere to read\n    // from as soon as it comes up.\n    s = js_KeyValue(&gDeskKv, js, \"DESK_STATE\");\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        kvConfig kvcfg;\n        natsStatus initStatus = kvConfig_Init(&kvcfg);\n        if (initStatus != NATS_OK) {\n            printf(\"kvConfig_Init failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(initStatus));\n            return 1;\n        }\n        kvcfg.Bucket = \"DESK_STATE\";\n        kvcfg.History = 1;\n        s = js_CreateKeyValue(&gDeskKv, js, &kvcfg);\n        if (s != NATS_OK) {\n            printf(\"DESK_STATE KV setup failed: %s\\n\", natsStatus_GetText(s));\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    kvKeysList keysList;\n    memset(&keysList, 0, sizeof(keysList));\n    s = kvStore_Keys(&keysList, metaKv, nullptr);\n    if (s                 "text": "Yes \u2014 it's the *same* lock object, passed by reference all the way down the call chain, not two separate locks.\n\n`onMD` creates one `std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(gMutex);` at the top of the function. That single object then flows: `onMD` \u2192 `noteBookEventAndCheckBurst(..., lock)` \u2192 `attemptRelSample(..., lock)`. Everyone in that chain is operating on the one lock `onMD` owns \u2014 `noteBookEventAndCheckBurst` doesn't lock anything itself, it just forwards the reference it received on to `attemptRelSample`, exactly the way `onMD` already forwards its own `lock` into `requoteInstrument` today.\n\nThat's precisely why this works safely: when `attemptRelSample` calls `lock.unlock()`, it's unlocking `gMutex` itself (the actual mutex, not some local copy), and everyone up the chain \u2014 `noteBookEventAndCheckBurst`, `onMD` \u2014 sees `gMutex` as unlocked for that window too, because there's only one lock in play. feeds.size(); ++j) {\n            if (gFeedClusterSignature.count(feeds[j])) continue;\n            InstrumentState& A = gInstruments[feeds[i]];\n            InstrumentState& B = gInstruments[feeds[j]];\n            if (static_cast<int>(A.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints ||\n                static_cast<int>(B.midHistory.size()) < cfg::kMinOverlapPoints) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            PairFit f = bestFit(A, B);\n            if (f.r2 >= cfg::kR2Floor) {\n                uf.unite(feeds[i], feeds[j]);\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PAIR_RELATED,\" << feeds[i] << \"-\" << feeds[j]\n                                  << \",r2=\" << f.r2 << \";lag=\" << f.lag\n                                  << \";aLeadsB=\" << (f.aLeadsB ? 1 : 0) << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> components;\n    for (auto& feed : feeds) {\n        if (gFeedClusterSignature.count(feed)) continue;  // frozen, not part of this pass's churn\n        if (uf.parent.count(feed)) components[uf.find(feed)].push_back(feed);\n    }\n\n    // -- \u00a72.3: cluster lock debounce --\n    std::set<std::string> currentSignatures;\n    for (auto& kv : components) {\n        std::vector<std::string>& members = kv.second;\n        if (members.size() < 2) continue;\n        std::string sig = clusterSignature(members);\n        currentSignatures.insert(sig);\n        int& count = gClusterStability[sig];\n        count++;\n        if (count >= cfg::kClusterStablePasses && !gLockedClusterSignatures.count(sig)) {\n            gLockedClusterSignatures.insert(sig);\n            for (auto& f : members) gFeedClusterSignature[f] = sig;\n            printf(\"CLUSTER LOCKED: %s\\n\", sig.c_str());\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",CLUSTER_LOCKED,\" << sig << \",\\n\";\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Any signature not observed this pass had its membership change --\n    // its stability streak is broken, reset it so a stale count can't\n    // later combine with an unrelated future streak.\n    for (auto it = gClusterStability.begin(); it != gClusterStability.end();) {\n        if (!currentSignatures.count(it->first)) it = gClusterStability.erase(it);\n        else ++it;\n    }\n\n    // -- \u00a72.4: driver identification, debounced, only within locked clusters\n    //    that don't already have a driver locked --\n    for (const std::string& sig : gLockedClusterSignatures) {\n        if (gDriverLockedSignatures.count(sig)) continue;  // frozen already\n\n        std::vector<std::string> members;\n        for (auto& kv : gFeedClusterSignature) {\n            if (kv.second == sig) members.push_back(kv.first);\n        }\n\n        std::string bestFeed, bestSender;\n        double bestFrac = 0.0;\n        int strongCount = 0;\n        for (auto& feed : members) {\n            InstrumentState& st = gInstruments[feed];\n            if (st.totalTrades < cfg::kTradeWarmup) continue;\n            std::string domSender;\n            long long domCount = 0;\n            for (auto& sc : st.senderTradeCount) {\n                if (sc.second > domCount) {\n                    domCount = sc.second;\n                    domSender = sc.first;\n                }\n            }\n            double frac = st.totalTrades > 0 ? static_cast<double>(domCount) / st.totalTrades : 0.0;\n            if (frac >= cfg::kDominanceFloor) {\n                strongCount++;\n                if (frac > bestFrac) {\n                    bestFrac = frac;\n                    bestFeed = feed;\n                    bestSender = domSender;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (strongCount != 1) {\n            // Ambiguous or nobody dominant yet -- reset the debounce\n            // counter rather than let a stale streak carry through a\n            // momentary flicker.\n            gDriverCandidateStability.erase(sig);\n            if (strongCount > 1 && gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER,\" << sig << \",\\n\";\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        auto& cand = gDriverCandidateStability[sig];\n        if (cand.first == bestFeed) {\n            cand.second++;\n        } else {\n            cand.first = bestFeed;\n            cand.second = 1;\n        }\n\n        if (cand.second >= cfg::kDriverStablePasses) {\n            InstrumentState& driverSt = gInstruments[bestFeed];\n            driverSt.isDriver = true;\n            driverSt.moverSender = bestSender;\n            gDriverLockedSignatures.insert(sig);\n            printf(\"DRIVER LOCKED: %s, mover=%s\\n\", bestFeed.c_str(), bestSender.c_str());\n            if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",DRIVER_LOCKED,\" << bestFeed\n                              << \",mover=\" << bestSender << \";frac=\" << bestFrac << \"\\n\";\n            }\n            for (auto& feed : members) {\n                if (feed == bestFeed) continue;\n                InstrumentState& pig = gInstruments[feed];\n                pig.isPiggyback = true;\n                pig.driverFeed = bestFeed;\n                // \u00a73.1: sample collection starts fresh, live, forward-only\n                // from the moment of lock -- do not reuse anything from the\n                // discovery-phase history above, it was never filtered for\n                // mover contamination.\n                pig.relSamples.clear();\n                pig.relSamplesSeenTotal = 0;\n                pig.relTrusted = false;\n                if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) {\n                    gDiscoveryLog << nowNanos() << \",PIGGYBACK_LOCKED,\" << feed\n                                  << \",driver=\" << bestFeed << \"\\n\";\n                }\n            }\n            gDriverCandidateStability.erase(sig);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a73: Offset (rel) recovery -- burst-triggered, contamination-guarded\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Updates \u00a73.2/\u00a73.3 \"how long has the mover held the current best price\"\n// tracking for one side. Call after bidPx/askPx are updated and liveOrders\n// is current for this instrument.\nstatic void updateMoverOwnershipTimer(InstrumentState& pig, const std::string& mover) {\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    if (mover.empty()) return;\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', mover)) {\n        if (pig.lastMoverBidPx != pig.bidPx) {\n            pig.moverBidSince = nowTp;\n            pig.lastMoverBidPx = pig.bidPx;\n        }\n    } else {\n        pig.lastMoverBidPx = -2;\n    }\n\n    if (bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', mover)) {\n        if (pig.lastMoverAskPx != pig.askPx) {\n            pig.moverAskSince = nowTp;\n            pig.lastMoverAskPx = pig.askPx;\n        }\n    } else {\n        pig.lastMoverAskPx = -2;\n    }\n}\n\n// Attempts one rel sample from a detected requote burst. Returns having\n// either taken a sample (adding to relSamples / possibly trusting) or\n// having skipped, per the contamination rules in \u00a73.2/\u00a73.3.\nstatic void attemptRelSample(InstrumentState& pig, long long burstTs,\n                              std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock) {\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n    if (pig.bidPx < 0 || pig.askPx < 0) return;\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    long long effBid = pig.bidPx, effAsk = pig.askPx;\n\n    bool moverOnBid = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool moverOnAsk = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    if (moverOnBid) {\n        bool stale = (nowTp - pig.moverBidSince) >= cfg::kContaminationTimeout;\n        if (!stale) return;  // \u00a73.2: active contamination, skip entirely\n        long long alt = bestPriceExcludingSender(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n        if (alt < 0) return;  // \u00a73.3(a): no fallback level available, skip\n        effBid = alt;\n    }\n    if (moverOnAsk) {\n        bool stale = (nowTp - pig.moverAskSince) >= cfg::kContaminationTimeout;\n        if (!stale) return;\n        long long alt = bestPriceExcludingSender(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n        if (alt < 0) return;\n        effAsk = alt;\n    }\n\n    // Anchor to fv(driver) as of the burst's own wire timestamp, not\n    // whatever gInstruments[driverFeed] currently holds -- ex.bbo.<driver>\n    // and ex.md.<piggyback>.* are separate NATS subjects with no\n    // cross-subject ordering guarantee, so \"live\" driver state can already\n    // be one or more ticks ahead of what the LP actually saw when it\n    // repriced. valueAtOrBefore gives the causally-correct fv instead.\n    double driverFv;\n    if (!valueAtOrBefore(drv.midHistory, burstTs, driverFv)) return;  // no anchored driver fv yet\n    double center = (static_cast<double>(effBid) + static_cast<double>(effAsk)) / 2.0;\n    double sample = center - driverFv;\n\n    pig.relSamples.push_back(sample);\n    while (pig.relSamples.size() > cfg::kRelWindow) pig.relSamples.pop_front();\n    pig.relSamplesSeenTotal++;\n\n    if (!pig.relTrusted) {\n        printf(\"REL SAMPLE #%lld = %.4f\\n\", pig.relSamplesSeenTotal, sample);\n    }\n\n    if (pig.relSamples.size() < cfg::kRelMinSamples) return;\n    printf(\"beginning mean and std calculation!\\n\");\n    std::vector<double> v(pig.relSamples.begin(), pig.relSamples.end());\n    double m = meanOf(v);\n    double var = 0.0;\n    for (double x : v) var += (x - m) * (x - m);\n    var /= static_cast<double>(v.size());\n    double sd = std::sqrt(var);\n    long long driverTick = drv.meta.ticksize > 0 ? drv.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    double sdTicks = sd / static_cast<double>(driverTick);\n    printf(\"sdTicks = %.2f\", sdTicks, \"\\n\");\n\n    bool wasTrusted = pig.relTrusted;\n    if (sdTicks < cfg::kRelTrustStdTicks) {\n        pig.rel = m;\n        pig.relTrusted = true;\n    }\n    // Note: once trusted, we don't revoke trust on a later noisy sample --\n    // \u00a73.4 doesn't ask for that, and doing so would reopen the door to\n    // exactly the kind of instability the fixed-offset design in \u00a75 is\n    // trying to avoid. New samples still accumulate and refine `rel`.\n\nif (pig.relTrusted && !wasTrusted) {\n    std::string feed = pig.feed, driverFeed = pig.driverFeed;\n    double rel = pig.rel;\n    lock.unlock();\n    publishPairing(feed, driverFeed, rel);\n    lock.lock();\n\n    printf(\"REL TRUSTED: driver=%s rel=%.4f sdTicks=%.3f\\n\", pig.driverFeed.c_str(), pig.rel, sdTicks);\n    printf(\"LIVE - quoting %s\\n\", pig.feed.c_str());\n    if (gDiscoveryLog.is_open()) { /* unchanged, still under lock */ }\n} else if (pig.relTrusted) {\n    std::string feed = pig.feed, driverFeed = pig.driverFeed;\n    double rel = pig.rel;\n    lock.unlock();\n    publishPairing(feed, driverFeed, rel);\n    lock.lock();\n}\n}\n\n// \u00a73.1: called on every A/C for this piggyback's own book. Detects a\n// requote burst -- a batch of cancels immediately followed by a batch of\n// adds, spanning both book sides, all from ONE sender -- and, on\n// detection, attempts exactly one rel sample.\n//\n// Grouping by sender (rather than pooling \"any sender\" together, as this\n// used to) matters for two reasons: (1) it makes a detected burst mean\n// \"one LP actor re-quoting,\" not incidental overlap of unrelated senders'\n// unrelated cancels/adds landing in the same window; (2) it lets us\n// exclude `moverSender` outright -- if the mover itself is touching this\n// book, any resulting churn isn't the LP repricing signal we're after,\n// it's the contamination case we already know can happen, so we skip it\n// at detection time rather than relying solely on the top-of-book\n// contamination guard in attemptRelSample.\n//\n// The anchor for the fv lookup is the wire timestamp of this sender's\n// FIRST cancel in the qualifying sequence, not the completing 'A' -- that\n// is the earliest point at which this sender is known to be reacting, so\n// it's the tightest causally-safe anchor available.\nstatic void noteBookEventAndCheckBurst(InstrumentState& pig, char msgType, long long wireTs,\n                                        const std::string& sender, char side,\n                                        std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock) {\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback) return;\n    if (sender.empty()) return;  // can't group what we can't attribute\n\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    const std::string moverSender =\n        (itDriver != gInstruments.end()) ? itDriver->second.moverSender : std::string();\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    SenderBurstTracker& tr = pig.senderBursts[sender];\n\n    auto prune = [&](std::deque<BurstEvent>& dq) {\n        while (!dq.empty() && nowTp - dq.front().localTime > cfg::kBurstWindow) dq.pop_front();\n    };\n\n    if (msgType == 'C') {\n        tr.recentCancels.push_back({nowTp, wireTs, side});\n        prune(tr.recentCancels);\n        return;\n    }\n    if (msgType != 'A') return;\n\n    tr.recentAdds.push_back({nowTp, wireTs, side});\n    prune(tr.recentAdds);\n    prune(tr.recentCancels);\n\n    if (sender == moverSender) return;  // exclude the identified mover explicitly\n\n    bool enoughCancels = static_cast<int>(tr.recentCancels.size()) >= cfg::kBurstMinCancels;\n    bool enoughAdds = static_cast<int>(tr.recentAdds.size()) >= cfg::kBurstMinAdds;\n    bool cooledDown = (nowTp - tr.lastBurstSampleAttempt) >= cfg::kBurstCooldown;\n\n    bool sawBid = false, sawAsk = false;\n    for (const auto& e : tr.recentCancels) { sawBid |= (e.side == 'B'); sawAsk |= (e.side == 'S'); }\n    for (const auto& e : tr.recentAdds)     { sawBid |= (e.side == 'B'); sawAsk |= (e.side == 'S'); }\n    bool spansBothSides = sawBid && sawAsk;\n\n    if (enoughCancels && enoughAdds && spansBothSides && cooledDown) {\n        tr.lastBurstSampleAttempt = nowTp;\n        long long anchorTs = tr.recentCancels.front().wireTs;  // this sender's first cancel in the sequence\n        attemptRelSample(pig, anchorTs, lock);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a74: continuous driver fair-value tracking\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Called on every market-data event (BBO change or trade) for a driver\n// instrument. Recomputes fv(driver) and, if it differs from the value last\n// used to quote, reprices every live dependent piggyback immediately.\n// Forward-declared here, defined after requoteInstrument below.\nstatic void requoteInstrument(InstrumentState& st, std::unique_lock<std::mutex>& lock);\n\nstatic void requestRequote(const std::string& feed) {\n    {\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> qlock(gRequoteQueueMutex);\n        gPendingRequotes.insert(feed);\n    }\n    gRequoteCV.notify_one();\n}\n\n// `lock` is the caller's already-held std::unique_lock on gMutex (same one\n// the caller got from onBBO/onMD). Passed straight through to\n// requoteInstrument, which unlocks/relocks it internally around its own\n// network round trip -- see requoteInstrument for why this is safe to do\n// repeatedly across several dependents in this loop rather than a deadlock\n// risk: it's the same lock object being handed down, not a fresh lock.\nstatic void checkDriverFvUpdate(InstrumentState& drv) {\n    if (!drv.isDriver) return;\n    double newFv = fairValue(drv);\n\n    if (drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv && newFv == drv.lastUsedDriverFv) return;\n\n    double oldFv = drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv ? drv.lastUsedDriverFv : newFv;\n    bool first = !drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv;\n    drv.lastUsedDriverFv = newFv;\n    drv.haveLastUsedDriverFv = true;\n    if (first) return;\n\n    std::vector<std::string> dependents;\n    for (auto& kv : gInstruments) {\n        if (kv.second.isPiggyback && kv.second.driverFeed == drv.feed && kv.second.relTrusted) {\n            dependents.push_back(kv.first);\n        }\n    }\n    if (dependents.empty()) return;\n\n    std::ostringstream depList;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < dependents.size(); ++i) {\n        if (i) depList << \",\";\n        depList << dependents[i];\n    }\n    printf(\"DRIVER FV UPDATED: %s old=%.4f new=%.4f -> repricing %s\\n\", drv.feed.c_str(), oldFv, newFv,\n           depList.str().c_str());\n\n    for (auto& feed : dependents) {\n        requestRequote(feed);\n    }\n}\n\n\n// ============================================================================\n// \u00a75: Quoting\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DesiredQuote {\n    bool haveBid = false, haveAsk = false;\n    long long bidPx = 0, askPx = 0;\n    long long bidVol = 0, askVol = 0;\n};\n\nstatic void printBlockedTransition(InstrumentState& pig, char side, bool nowBlocked,\n                                    const std::string& reason) {\n    bool& flag = (side == 'B') ? pig.bidBlocked : pig.askBlocked;\n    const char* label = (side == 'B') ? \"BID\" : \"ASK\";\n    if (nowBlocked && !flag) {\n        printf(\"%s blocked: %s (%s)\\n\", label, pig.feed.c_str(), reason.c_str());\n    } else if (!nowBlocked && flag) {\n        printf(\"%s unblocked: %s\\n\", label, pig.feed.c_str());\n    }\n    flag = nowBlocked;\n}\n\n// Drivers are never quoted. Only piggybacks with a trusted rel get quotes,\n// priced at c = fv(driver) + rel, fixed +/-N ticks (\u00a75) -- not ratcheted to\n// any historical extreme.\nstatic DesiredQuote computeQuotes(InstrumentState& pig) {\n    DesiredQuote q;\n    if (!pig.isPiggyback || !pig.relTrusted) return q;\n    auto itDriver = gInstruments.find(pig.driverFeed);\n    if (itDriver == gInstruments.end()) return q;\n    InstrumentState& drv = itDriver->second;\n\n    double driverFv = fairValue(drv);\n    double center = driverFv + pig.rel;\n\n    long long tick = pig.meta.ticksize > 0 ? pig.meta.ticksize : 1;\n    long long halfSpread = cfg::kQuoteHalfSpreadTicks * tick;\n\n    long long bidPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(center / tick)) * tick - halfSpread;\n    long long askPx = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(center / tick)) * tick + halfSpread;\n    if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n\n    // meta.band restricts how far from ref_price quotes may sit -- clamp\n    // into it, and warn once if the fixed half-spread doesn't fit.\n    if (pig.meta.band > 0) {\n        long long lo = pig.meta.ref_price - pig.meta.band;\n        long long hi = pig.meta.ref_price + pig.meta.band;\n        if ((hi - lo) < 2 * halfSpread && !pig.bandWarningPrinted) {\n            printf(\"WARNING: %s meta.band (+/-%lld) is narrower than the configured quote \"\n                   \"half-spread (%lld); quotes will be clamped into the band.\\n\",\n                   pig.feed.c_str(), pig.meta.band, halfSpread);\n            pig.bandWarningPrinted = true;\n        }\n        bidPx = std::max(bidPx, lo);\n        askPx = std::min(askPx, hi);\n        if (askPx <= bidPx) askPx = bidPx + tick;\n    }\n\n    long long size = std::max<long long>(pig.meta.min_volume, 1);  // \u00a70: flat size, deliberate for this test\n\n    auto nowTp = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n    bool bidPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseBidUntil;\n    bool askPaused = nowTp < pig.pauseAskUntil;\n    bool bidMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'B', drv.moverSender);\n    bool askMoverOwned = bestPriceOwnedBy(pig, 'S', drv.moverSender);\n\n    bool bidBlocked = bidPaused || bidMoverOwned;\n    bool askBlocked = askPaused || askMoverOwned;\n    printBlockedTransition(pig, 'B', bidBlocked, bidPaused ? \"fill-burst pause\" : \"mover owns level\");\n    printBlockedTransition(pig, 'S', askBlocked, askPaused ? \"fill-burst pause\" : \"mover owns level\");\n\n    if (!bidBlocked) {\n        q.haveBid = true;\n        q.bidPx = bidPx;\n        q.bidVol = size;\n    }\n    if (!askBlocked) {\n        q.haveAsk = true;\n        q.askPx = askPx;\n        q.askVol = size;\n    }\n    return q;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Order entry -- wire format confirmed against PROTOCOL.md, unchanged.\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic bool addOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId, char side,\n                      long long volume, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s A %s %s %c %lld %lld L\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(),\n             orderId.c_str(), side, volume, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] addOrder request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    if (!replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y') return true;\n    printf(\"[%s] addOrder rejected: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), replyStr.c_str());\n    return false;\n}\n\nstatic bool cancelOrder(const std::string& feed, const std::string& orderId) {\n    if (orderId.empty()) return true;\n    char natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\n// Sends \"<SENDER> X <FEED> <side> <price>\" -- cancels whatever of our own\n// orders are resting on that side at that price in one round trip. Used\n// instead of single-order cancelOrder()/C in requoteInstrument's network\n// phase per requote_fix_instructions.md step 2: fewer round trips, and it\n// also cleans up any order left resting from a stale (since-superseded)\n// requote attempt whose write-back was discarded in step 3, since that\n// order is targeted by side+price rather than by an id we may no longer\n// have on hand.\nstatic bool bulkCancelSide(const std::string& feed, char side, long long price) {\n    char msg[256];\n    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), \"%s X %s %c %lld\", gSender.c_str(), feed.c_str(), side, price);\n    char subject[64];\n    snprintf(subject, sizeof(subject), \"ex.req.%s\", gSender.c_str());\n\n    natsMsg* reply = nullptr;\n    natsStatus s = natsConnection_RequestString(&reply, gConn, subject, msg, 2000);\n    if (s != NATS_OK) {\n        printf(\"[%s] bulkCancelSide request failed: %s\\n\", feed.c_str(), natsStatus_GetText(s));\n        return false;\n    }\n    std::string replyStr(natsMsg_GetData(reply), natsMsg_GetDataLength(reply));\n    natsMsg_Destroy(reply);\n    return !replyStr.empty() && replyStr[0] == 'Y';\n}\n\nstatic std::string nextOrderId(InstrumentState& st) {\n    char buf[9];\n    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), \"%.4s%04lld\", st.feed.c_str(), (st.orderSeq++) % 10000);\n    return std::string(buf);\n}\n\n// Everything requoteInstrument's step 1 needs to hand off to the unlocked\n// network phase (step 2), and back to the write-back phase (step 3).\nstruct RequotePlan {\n    long long version = 0;\n    std::string feed;\n\n    bool doCancelBid = false, doCancelAsk = false;\n    long long cancelBidPx = -1, cancelAskPx = -1;\n\n    bool doAddBid = false, doAddAsk = false;\n    std::string addBidId, addAskId;\n    long long addBidPx = 0, addBidVol = 0;\n    long long addAskPx = 0, addAskVol = 0;\n};\n\n// Cancel-and-replace both sides if the desired quote differs from what's\n// currently resting. Called both reactively (the instant something that\n// should move our price happens -- \u00a74's driver-fv-change trigger, plus a\n// piggyback's own book events) and from a bounded safety-net loop.\n//\n// The caller holds `lock` (a std::unique_lock on gMutex) on entry, exactly\n// as it would have held a lock_guard before this fix -- none of the four\n// call sites are restructured, they just pass a unique_lock instead of a\n// lock_guard so it CAN be released mid-scope. That line got replaced by the safety-net snapshot loop instead of sitting alongside it. As written now, **no instrument ever gets inserted into `gInstruments`** \u2014 `st` is built, then discarded when it goes out of scope at the end of the `for` loop iteration in `main`. `onBBO`/`onMD` will do `gInstruments.find(feed)`, get `end()`, and silently return every time.                 "text": "That's the right move, and the reasoning holds up. Walk through why: your LP's ladder is symmetric \u2014 best bid = c \u2212 offset, best ask = c + offset. So mid(best bid, best ask) = c exactly. You don't need rel at all to get c; you just need to read the two best prices off the book once the LP has actually posted them. That's a huge simplification \u2014 you're going from *reconstructing a hidden constant through async, unordered NATS messages* to *reading a number that's sitting directly in the book*. The first is genuinely hard (you were fighting causality itself). The second is just \"read the BBO.\"\n\nTwo things worth being precise about before you build it, though:\n\n**1. Your trigger condition is a proxy, not exact \u2014 and that's fine, but know why.** The LP's true reprice event is `round(fv(driver) + rel)` crossing an integer, not `round(fv(driver))` crossing one. Since rel just shifts where the rounding boundary sits, your raw-fv trigger will fire at roughly the same *rate* as the real event, just occasionally a tick or two early/late. That's totally acceptable for \"get defensive\" \u2014 you're not using this number for precision, you're using it as a warning to pull orders. The precision now comes entirely from your *observation after the fact*, not from the trigger. Worth writing that distinction explicitly in NOTES.md \u2014 it's the whole reason this design is more robust: you've decoupled \"when to act cautious\" (approximate, cheap) from \"what price to trust\" (exact, directly observed).\n\n**2. Two mechanical gotchas that'll bite you if you don't handle them:**\n- **Pull your own resting orders *before* you read the new best bid/ask.** If your own quote is still sitting in the book when you compute mid, you're contaminating your own fair-value read with your own price. This is the same contamination-guard idea you already had, just simpler \u2014 one check at one moment, not a running filter over hundreds of samples.\n- **Burst completion.** The LP reposts one order at a time (protocol constraint). If you read BBO mid-burst \u2014 after cancel-all but before all adds have landed \u2014 you'll get a partial or empty book, not the real ladder. You need some signal that the repost is *done*: e.g. BBO stops changing for a short debounce window, or you count adds-since-last-cancel and expect it to reach the LP's known `levels` count (which you can learn once and cache, since it's fixed at bot startup). Either works; the debounce-on-stability approach is simpler to implement and doesn't require you to have already learned `levels`.\n\nOne thing to pin down: when you say \"fill out the LPs themselves instead of waiting for a taker\" \u2014 is that *replacing* passive resting quotes, or *on top of* them? If it's active crossing right after you observe their fresh ladder, your edge source is real and worth naming explicitly (so you don't second-guess it as luck later): the LP centered on `fv(driver)` as of when their cancel fired, but the driver kept moving during their multi-message repost. If you hit their ladder the instant it completes, you're capturing the driver's drift during their own latency \u2014 that's an information-lag edge, not a speed race. Different from the \"outrun the LP\" problem you correctly diagnosed as unwinnable, because you're not racing to be *first*, you're exploiting the fact that *their own post is already stale by the time it lands*.\n\nDoes the plan keep resting two-sided quotes at all, or is it now pure \"observe \u2192 cross\" per piggyback?",
